title: Senior Typescript/Vue 3 Developer
description:
We are a software development company seeking an additional team member for immediate assistance with client projects. This is a great opportunity for an ongoing relationship, with the potential for a full-time position if things go well.



We are looking for a senior front-end developer to help with web development of a medium sized application. If you are a full-stack developer, please apply also, as we have back-end work (that is a different role we’ll be hiring for, but if you’re strong in Python, let us know).



The initial scope is for 40 hours per week.



The project will be to develop part of the front-end, using Vue3 (composition API, typescript) along with vite, pinia, vitest (jest experience is OK).



We want a senior engineer, who can solve difficult problems, as well as manage other developers.



The full dev stack is: typescript, Vue3 single file components (SFC, composition), Quasar Framework, Vite, Vitest, bash, github.



We need a senior developer who is comfortable writing clean maintainable code, and has dealt with things like server-sent-events, SSE resumption, well designed class structures, and full test suites (unit, functional and integration). You will be maintaining a TS library, and the app itself.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:



Must Have Skills:



- Experienced only: please *do not* apply if you are not an experienced developer.

- Coding: a lot of experience with front-end development (clean, maintainable and (advanced) typescript, html, css, bootstrap).

- Familiarity with either Cursor or Windsurf IDEs, and the agentic coding workflow.

- Test driven development: all of our coding starts with writing tests first. Please outline your experience with automated testing, preferably vitest or jest (or cypress or similar) for end-to-end testing.

- Typescript: typescript development experience (our core logic is in a typescript library that is compiled to JS using Vite and rollup). You must be very comfortable working in a strongly typed environment, writing types and classes, and following strong OOP patterns by default.

- HTML/CSS: strong with HTML and SCSS.

- Quasar: if you have experience with the Quasar framework, this is highly desired and you should highlight this in your application.

- PrimeVue, Syncfusion: we are evaluating these libraries and if you have production experience with them please let us know.

- End-to-end developer: Must have experience taking rich mockups (e.g. Canva or Figma) with sophisticated design and converting them into fully working front-end code. Note you will be working alongside a designer. “Done” would mean: 1) library/service classes built; 2) GUI built; 3) extensive test suite that covers all that code; 4) documentation written. If you are not used to working like that, this might not be a fit for you.

- “Design thinking”: we want a senior developer who knows how to think through designing codebases that scale. i.e. using tests, writing clean code, documentation, etc.

- CI/CD: must be familiar with using Github, bash scripts, etc.

- Must have had experience managing/leading other devs. Even if its a small team.



Desirable (but not required) skills:



- Visual Design Sensibility: whilst we have a designer you can work with, it would be good if you have some design sensibility, and are able to implement “nice” looking pages without help from a designer. Please highlight your skill in this area.

- Backend (python): whilst *not* a requirement, it would be a big plus if you have experience working on the backend as well (i.e. you’re a full-stack developer). Our backend is a python FastAPI set of webservices.

- Backend (other): if you don’t have backend experience with python, but do have it in other languages (e.g. c# /, or node or next.js etc) then please include information about that.

- Automation: comfortable writing scripts (e.g. build scripts for npm run build, etc) or deployment scripts in bash or powershell to help with CI/CD.

- Uses AI: if you are using any AI coding tools we like that and we want to know about it! e.g. if you’re using Github co-pilot, or Windsurf or Cursor etc, please let us know. We love AI and use it a lot ourselves, so this is a plus not a negative.

title: Google Ads Manager — Experienced
description:
Rate: Starting at $6/hr — flexible based on experience and what you can bring to the table

Schedule?: 8 AM–5 PM CST

Experience: Experienced only — not an entry-level position



We’re looking for an experienced Google Ads Manager who knows Google Ads inside and out and can independently set up, manage, optimize, and troubleshoot campaigns.



Our primary focus is service-based businesses, so proven experience generating leads and conversions for service businesses is highly preferred. Experience with professional services such as law firms, accounting firms, financial services, or similar businesses is a strong plus.



What You’ll Do

- Set up and launch Google Ads campaigns from scratch

- Check campaign performance weekly and identify areas for improvement

- Continuously optimize campaigns to drive more conversions and qualified leads

- Manage and optimize Search and Performance Max campaigns

- Conduct keyword research and optimize search terms, match types, negative keywords, bids, budgets, and targeting

-Analyze campaign data and provide actionable recommendations based on performance

- Identify wasted spend and opportunities to scale what’s working

- Monitor cost per lead, conversion rates, and overall campaign efficiency

- Troubleshoot campaign and conversion tracking issues

- Respond to client questions regarding campaign performance (through the CSM)

- Clearly explain campaign results, insights, and recommendations to clients



What We’re Looking For

- Several years of hands-on Google Ads experience

- Proven success generating qualified leads for service-based businesses

- Strong understanding of Google Ads strategy, structure, bidding, keywords, search intent, conversion tracking, and optimization

- Experience managing campaigns independently

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- Ability to look at campaign data and determine what needs to change and why

- Strong written and verbal communication

- Professional and confident when communicating with clients

- Professional services experience is a major plus, especially law firms, accounting firms, insurance, financial services, or similar businesses



Bonus: Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL), particularly with lead tracking, CRM, attribution, or client accounts.



Future Growth:

As you become familiar with our processes and clients, you may also be trained to assist with minor client onboarding calls and client check-ins.

This won’t be the primary focus of the role, but we’re looking for someone comfortable communicating with clients and interested in taking on additional responsibilities over time.



About Us:

We’re a growing digital advertising company focused on helping local and service-based businesses generate qualified leads and grow their businesses.



We specialize in performance marketing, using platforms like Google Ads and
 Ads, with a strong focus on measurable results, continuous optimization, and turning advertising spend into actual customers and revenue.



Compensation:

The starting rate is $6/hour, but we are flexible for the right candidate. If you have exceptional experience and can demonstrate significant value, we’re open to discussing a higher rate.



How to Apply:

Please submit all of the following:



1. Resume: Send an accessible link to your resume.

2. 1–3 minute voice recording: Introduce yourself and tell us about your most successful Google Ads campaign. Tell us what the business was, what you did, and the results you achieved.

3. Brief experience summary: Tell us how many years you’ve managed Google Ads, what types of service-based businesses you’ve worked with, and whether you have professional services experience.



Please do not apply if you’re a beginner or are still learning the fundamentals of Google Ads.



We’re looking for someone who can take a campaign, understand what’s happening, make smart decisions, provide clear recommendations, and drive results with minimal hand-holding.

title: Customer care exceutive cum BDE partime
Full-Time AI & Technology Assistant (Real Estate) – Love AI? Love Learning? We Want You!
description:
Are you the type of person who gets excited when a new AI tool is released?



Do you enjoy figuring out how technology works and then using it to make businesses run better?



Do you enjoy talking with people and helping them?



If you're naturally curious, love learning, and enjoy following step-by-step instructions to build systems, then this could be the perfect career opportunity for you.



We are a growing U.S. real estate company looking for a reliable, intelligent, and detail-oriented tea
mber to become our **AI & Technology Assistant**.



This is not just another virtual assistant position.



You'll become an important part of our business by helping us build better systems using Artificial Intelligence and modern business software while also speaking with homeowners who have already expressed interest in selling their property.



You'll receive ongoing training, work directly with business owners, and continually learn new skills that will make you extremely valuable in today's marketplace.



What You'll Be Doing



Your responsibilities may include:



* Learning and using the latest AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and others)

* Following tutorials and instructions from AI experts to build business tools and automations

* Creating prompts and improving AI workflows

* Building and maintaining automations

* Setting up and organizing CRM systems

* Researching new AI software and testing it

* Documenting processes and creating step-by-step instructions

* Organizing data and keeping projects moving

* Calling **warm homeowner leads** using a simple 3-question script

* Scheduling appointments for our real estate team

* Occasionally performing a live transfer when a homeowner wants to speak with us immediately



These are **warm leads**—people who have already shown interest. This is **not cold calling**, and you won't need to memorize a complicated sales presentation. If you can follow a simple script, smile while you speak, and build a little rapport, you'll do great.



 Incredible Bonus Opportunity



In addition to your monthly salary, you'll have the opportunity to earn **performance bonuses**.



Every appointment you help create can lead to substantial bonus opportunities. Many of our tea
mbers have the potential to **double or even triple their monthly income**, and exceptional performers can earn even more.



Your income is largely determined by your effort, reliability, and willingness to improve.



There is **no limit on your growth**.



Bonus Skills (Not Required)



You'll stand out if you have experience with any of these:



* GoHighLevel (GHL)

* Real estate

* CRM software

* Zapier

* 

* Google Workspace

* Excel or Google Sheets

* Basic prompt engineering

* API integrations

* No-code automation tools



Don't worry if you don't know all of these—we care much more about your willingness to learn than your current experience.



The Person We're Looking For



You might be a great fit if you:



* Love learning new technology

* Enjoy solving problems

* Have a friendly, confident speaking voice

* Feel comfortable talking with people over the phone

* Can follow a script naturally without sounding robotic

* Have clear English with little or no noticeable accent

* Follow directions carefully

* Have excellent attention to detail

* Are dependable and honest

* Like figuring things out on your own before asking for help

* Are organized and proactive

* Want a long-term career instead of just another job



Requirements



* Fast, reliable internet

* Quiet home office

* Reliable computer

* Excellent spoken and written English

* Comfortable using technology every day

* Able to learn quickly from videos and written instructions



We invest in people who invest in themselves.



How to Apply



To show us that you pay attention to details, please begin your application with this exact sentence:



**"AI is the future, and I'm excited to help build it."**



Then answer the following:



1. Tell us about yourself.

2. What AI tools have you used?

3. Have you used ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, or other AI software? What did you use them for?

4. Have you ever used GoHighLevel? Describe your experience.

5. Have you ever worked in real estate? If so, what was your role?

6. Tell us about a time you learned a completely new software program.

7. Are you comfortable speaking with homeowners on the phone and following a simple script?

8. Please record a 2–3 minute video introducing yourself and telling us why you'd be a great fit.



We're looking for someone who wants to build a career, continuously learn AI, help grow our business, and be rewarded for exceptional performance.



We pay 13th month bonus year-end and are aggressive with merit raises when you bring us home buyer and seller prospects  by following our simple but effective routines!



If that sounds like you, we'd love to meet you!

title: Controller
description:
We are seeking an experienced Controller to lead and oversee the company’s accounting and financial operations. This role requires a hands-on finance leader who can manage the full accounting cycle while providing management with clear visibility into cash flow, profitability, margins, inventory, and overall financial performance.



The ideal candidate will have strong experience in distribution or wholesale, particularly with inventory accounting, COGS management, equipment sales, and margin analysis. Experience working with a U.S.-based company and understanding U.S. GAAP is required.



Because the company has recently undergone an acquisition, the Controller will also play an important role in post-acquisition financial integration, including improving reporting processes, supporting system integration, and developing reliable financial reporting for the new ownership structure.



Key Responsibilities



Accounting & Financial Operations



* Manage the company’s full-cycle accounting operations, including:



  * General Ledger

  * Accounts Payable

  * Accounts Receivable

  * Payroll

  * Bank and account reconciliations

  * Month-end and year-end close

* Maintain accurate and timely financial records in accordance with U.S. GAAP.

* Prepare and review financial statements, including:



  * Balance Sheet

  * Profit & Loss Statement

  * Cash Flow Statement

  * Supporting schedules

* Establish and maintain strong internal controls and accounting procedures.

* Coordinate with external CPAs, auditors, tax professionals, and other financial partners.

* Ensure accounting deadlines, reporting requirements, and compliance obligations are consistently met.



Cash Flow & Financial Management



* Own the company’s cash flow management and forecasting process.

* Develop short-term and long-term cash flow forecasts.

* Monitor incoming customer payments and outgoing vendor, payroll, tax, and operating obligations.

* Identify potential cash flow issues and proactively communicate them to leadership.

* Provide recommendations to improve working capital and cash availability.

* Analyze financial performance and provide management with actionable recommendations.



Inventory, COGS & Distribution Accounting



* Oversee accounting for inventory, including:



  * Inventory costing

  * Valuation

  * Cycle counts

  * Adjustments

  * Shrinkage

* Monitor and analyze Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) and gross margins.

* Review equipment sales margins and identify profitability trends.

* Analyze inventory purchases, vendor costs, freight, and other costs affecting product margins.

* Work with operations and sales teams to ensure inventory and project costs are accurately captured.

* Develop reporting that provides visibility into profitability by product, customer, project, or business segment.



Post-Acquisition Integration



* Support the financial integration of the company following the recent acquisition.

* Assist with the integration of accounting processes, systems, financial records, and reporting requirements.

* Help establish consistent accounting policies and procedures under the new ownership structure.

* Support potential ERP or accounting-system migration and implementation.

* Develop and maintain accurate reporting for ownership and executive leadership.

* Prepare or support monthly management and board-level financial reporting packages.

* Establish KPIs and dashboards that provide ownership with clear visibility into financial performance.

* Ensure financial data from multiple entities or business units can be consolidated accurately when required.



Financial Analysis & Strategic Support



* Provide leadership with financial analysis to support business decisions.

* Analyze revenue, expenses, gross margins, operating costs, working capital, and profitability.

* Develop budgets, forecasts, and financial models.

* Identify cost-saving opportunities and areas for improving profitability.

* Evaluate the financial impact of major purchases, vendor agreements, projects, and business initiatives.

* Partner with leadership to establish financial targets and monitor performance against them.



Industry & Compliance Responsibilities



* Apply accounting knowledge relevant to medical equipment and distribution businesses.

* Understand the financial impact of OEM/vendor relationships, rebates, discounts, and partner agreements.

* Understand the accounting differences between capital equipment and consumable products.

* Maintain awareness of applicable sales-tax considerations related to medical equipment.

* Support compliance requirements applicable to the company’s healthcare-adjacent business relationships.

* Maintain appropriate documentation for financial transactions and vendor/customer relationships.



Qualifications



Required Experience



* 5–8+ years of accounting or finance experience.

* 2–3+ years of experience in a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accounting Manager role.

* Strong background in distribution, wholesale, or equipment-based businesses.

* Demonstrated experience managing full-cycle accounting.

* Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP.

* Experience with inventory accounting, COGS, and gross-margin analysis.

* Experience with cash flow forecasting and financial planning.

* Experience preparing and analyzing financial statements.

* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and financial modeling capabilities.

* Experience with accounting/ERP systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage, or similar platforms.

* Excellent written and spoken English.



Preferred Experience



* Medical device, medical equipment, healthcare, or healthcare-adjacent industry experience.

* Experience with post-acquisition integration.

* Experience working under a private equity, holding company, or investor-owned structure.

* Experience with multi-entity accounting and consolidation.

* Experience implementing or migrating ERP/accounting systems.

* Experience preparing investor, board, or PE-style reporting packages.

* Familiarity with vendor rebates and OEM partner agreements.

* Experience analyzing profitability for capital equipment sales.



Remote Work Requirements



* Previous experience working remotely with a U.S.-based team.

* Ability to maintain meaningful working-hour overlap with the U.S. Eastern Time Zone.

* Strong communication skills when working with executives, vendors, customers, OEM partners, and internal teams.

* Highly organized, self-directed, and capable of managing deadlines independently.

* Comfortable working with cloud-based accounting, communication, and business systems.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is more than a bookkeeper or financial reporting specialist. We are looking for a **hands-on Controller** who can understand the entire financial picture of the business and help leadership make better decisions.



This person should be able to clearly answer:



* How much cash do we have available?

* What cash is expected to come in and when?

* What payments and obligations are coming due?

* Which products, projects, and customers are most profitable?

* Where are margins being lost?

* How much capital is tied up in inventory?

* What is driving changes in COGS and gross margin?

* How is the business performing against budget and forecast?

* What financial risks should leadership be aware of?

* What actions can the company take to improve cash flow and profitability?



Key Success Measures



Success in this role will be measured by:



* Accurate and timely monthly financial close.

* Reliable financial statements and management reporting.

* Improved cash flow visibility and forecasting accuracy.

* Strong inventory and COGS controls.

* Accurate gross-margin and profitability reporting.

* Timely identification of financial risks and opportunities.

* Successful integration of accounting processes following the acquisition.

* Effective reporting to executive leadership and new ownership.

* Improved financial controls, processes, and operational efficiency.



How to Apply:



Please send the following to: 



Updated Resume/CV

Cover Letter explaining why your accounting and finance experience, particularly in full-cycle accounting, inventory, COGS, financial reporting, and cash flow management, makes you a strong fit for this Controller role.

Loom Video – Plus Point!



Candidates who submit a short Loom video explaining their relevant accounting and finance experience, leadership background, experience working with U.S.-based companies, and why they believe they are a strong fit for the Controller position will receive additional consideration.



Important:

Applications must be sent directly to 
 include the word “ONYX” somewhere in your application to demonstrate that you have read the entire job description and are not simply submitting a resume without reviewing the requirements.

title: Business Development Specialist / Sales Representative
description:
Business Development Specialist / Sales Representative

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–4:30 PM



About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Business Development Person who can take ownership of the sales process—from identifying and qualifying opportunities to developing relationships and ultimately closing deals. This is not simply a lead-generation role. We are looking for someone who has actually led the sales process, understands how to identify good opportunities, and can confidently move prospects through the sales cycle.



Key Responsibilities

- Identify, research, and qualify new business opportunities and potential clients.

- Generate and develop leads through outbound prospecting, research,
, LinkedIn, and other channels.

- Take ownership of the sales process from prospecting through closing.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with prospects, clients, and business partners.

- Conduct outreach and follow-ups with potential customers.

- Understand prospects' needs and identify opportunities that align with our services.

- Manage the sales pipeline and consistently follow up on active opportunities.

- Track leads, opportunities, communications, and sales activities using CRM systems.

- Collaborate with management to develop effective sales strategies and improve the sales process.

- Maintain accurate records and provide updates on pipeline activity, opportunities, and results.

- Identify ways to improve lead generation, conversion, and overall business development performance.



Requirements

- Minimum 5 years of sales experience, preferably working with US-based companies or clients.

- 8+ years of total professional experience is a strong plus.

- Proven experience in lead generation and business development.

- Demonstrated experience personally leading the sales process, not just generating leads.

- Ability to identify, qualify, develop, and close sales opportunities.

- Strong communication, negotiation, follow-up, and relationship-building skills.

- Experience working with different CRM platforms.

- Ability to work independently, manage a sales pipeline, and take ownership of results.

- Strong understanding of prospecting and outbound sales strategies.

- Experience working remotely with US-based teams or clients is preferred.



What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is someone who can say:

“I know how to find opportunities, build relationships, manage the sales process, and close business.”

We want someone who is results-driven, proactive, confident, and comfortable taking ownership of the entire sales cycle.

Updated Resume/CV

Cover Letter explaining why your sales and business development experience makes you a strong fit for this role.

title: Marketing & Executive Assistant - Video Editing, Lead Follow-Up, and Organization
description:

Your Growth



Most designers move from $800 to $1,250 per month within 6 months. From there you can keep rising to Senior Design Lead and beyond. We care about your growth and we invest in our people.



What You Get



    •    Paid training from day one

Landscape architects, landscape designers, and outdoor living designers who love design and want to grow. You do not need to know everything yet. We will teach you.

Send us:

title: Remote Outbound Appointment Setter and Virtual Sales Assistant
description:
Company: Febre Frameworks | Industry: Real estate photography and property-marketing media | Work arrangement: Remote | Schedule: Part-time pilot with Eastern Time availability 



Company Overview 



Febre Frameworks helps Florida real estate professionals coordinate professional property media, including photography, video, drone media, 3D tours, floor plans and virtual solutions. We are seeking a professional, dependable remote team member who can create a positive first impression, identify upcoming listing-media needs and accurately schedule qualified appointments. [S01–S05] 



Position Summary 



The Appointment Setter will make approved outbound and follow-up calls, respond to qualified leads, reactivate former customers, explain approved service options, schedule appointments, complete CRM notes and perform authorized follow-up. The role is consultative—not aggressive—and requires disciplined adherence to scripts, pricing rules, privacy controls and do-not-call procedures. 



Primary Responsibilities 



• Make live human calls to approved lead lists during authorized hours. 



• Follow approved opening, discovery, qualification, objection and booking language. 



• Ask concise questions about upcoming listings, media needs, timing, property details and decision authority. 



• Quote only from the current approved booking platform or price sheet. 



• Book service appointments or planning calls with complete and accurate details. 



• Enter call dispositions, notes, consent status, follow-up dates and opt-outs immediately. 



• Send approved follow-up
 or text only when legally and operationally authorized. 



• Escalate complaints, exceptions, pricing disputes and prior service issues to a manager. 



• Participate in call review, role-play, coaching and performance reporting. 



• Protect customer data and use company systems only for authorized business purposes. 



Required Qualifications 



• Excellent spoken and written English with clear, warm, professional delivery. 



• At least one year of outbound calling, lead qualification, customer service or appointment-setting experience. 



• Comfort handling rejection without becoming defensive, rushed or overly persistent. 



• Demonstrated accuracy using a CRM, scheduling system or structured database. 



• Ability to work a consistent Eastern Time schedule and attend live coaching. 



• Quiet, professional workspace and reliable technology. 



• Willingness to follow compliance rules exactly and stop contact immediately when requested. 



Preferred Qualifications 



• Experience with real estate, property media, home services, SaaS, BPO or U.S. professional services. 



• Experience reactivating former customers and following up on inbound leads. 



• Familiarity with photography, video, drone, Matterport/Zillow 3D, floor plans or virtual staging. 



• Experience working with Florida or U.S. real estate agents and brokerage teams. 



Technology and Work Environment 



• Modern computer capable of running a browser-based CRM, cloud phone and video meetings. 



• Wired USB headset with noise-canceling microphone; phone-speaker calling is not acceptable. 



• Stable primary internet connection; recommended company standard of at least 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload. 



• Backup internet such as a mobile hotspot and a documented power-outage plan. 



• Private workspace where customer information and calls cannot be overheard or recorded by others. 



• Multi-factor authentication and company-approved password manager are mandatory. 



Compensation and Trial 



Target base compensation: $5.50–$6.50 USD per hour depending on experience and paid-simulation results. Recommended initial offer: $5.75/hour plus approved performance incentives. The first 30 days are a paid pilot. Continued work depends on certification, reliability, quality, compliance and measurable contribution—not raw call volume alone. 



How to Apply 



• Submit a concise resume highlighting outbound calling and appointment-setting results. 



• Provide a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining how you handle rejection. 



• Answer every application question listed in Section 6. 



• Confirm your exact Eastern Time availability, equipment, internet and backup plan. 



• Include the phrase “TRUVIEW READY” in the first line of your response to demonstrate instruction-following. 



Initial Application Questions 



1. Describe your most recent outbound calling role. What product or service did you represent? 



2. How many hours per week did you spend on live calls, follow-up and CRM work? 



3. What did your team define as a qualified appointment? 



4. Provide your average or best documented contact, appointment, show or conversion metrics. Label estimates clearly. 



5. What experience do you have with real estate agents, brokerages, home services or property marketing? 



6. How do you respond after five consecutive rejections? 



7. Give an example of a prospect objection you handled successfully without offering an unauthorized discount. 



8. Which CRMs, dialers, scheduling platforms and communication tools have you used? 



9. Can you work 10:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday–Friday, consistently? List any conflicts. 



10. Describe your primary internet connection, backup connection and power-outage plan. 



11. What headset and computer do you use? Is your workspace private and quiet? 



12. What hourly rate do you require for a 30-hour-per-week pilot, and what rate would you expect after 90 days? 



13. Are you currently serving other clients during the same proposed hours? 



14. How do you record a do-not-call request and ensure the person is not contacted again? 



15. Explain the difference between a high number of bookings and a high-quality appointment-setting program.

title: Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Volume: 4 finished videos per day / 20–28 per week

Type: Long-term, full-time, ongoing — this is a career role, not a gig

Start: ASAP



About the role

I'm a full-time short-form creator posting 5–7 videos a day across TikTok and Instagram on multiple accounts. My niche content creations, class action lawsuits, AI tools, and consumer/product content, and I've done 100M+ views in the last 12 months.



I batch film, so you will never be waiting on footage. You'll have the bulk of my raw content well ahead of schedule and you'll work from a queue, staying at least one full day ahead of my posting calendar. The entire point of this role is that I never open my phone in the morning and find nothing ready to post.



I'm hiring one editor to own this long term. If you're reliable, this is a stable full-time salary with room to grow.



Your daily output

Every working day you deliver four finished, post-ready vertical videos:



1 × Greenscreen video

Me talking over a background of changing images. You source or build the background visuals, time each swap to what I'm saying, key the greenscreen cleanly, and make the cuts feel intentional. Clean keying and correctly timed image changes are the whole job here.



2 × Talking-head UGC edits

Tight cuts, filler and silence removal, onscreen artifacts. No captions or titles will need to be added, as I do this in TikTok and Instagram's native editors. These are the volume workhorses and should get faster as you build out templates.



1 × High-level promo video

Premium edit for a content-creation tool I promote. Motion graphics, screen recordings and app/UI overlays, animated text, mockups, zooms, sound design. This is the piece I'll judge your ceiling on — it needs to look like a real product ad, not a template.



You'll need to keep the pipeline organized with clear file naming, folder structure, and a short daily status on what's finished and what's queued. We can do this in Google Drive.



What I need from you (non-negotiables)

Full-time availability. Four videos a day including one premium edit is a real workday. This should be your main job, not something squeezed between other clients.



A one-day buffer, always. You have footage in advance, so there's no excuse for a same-day scramble. Finished videos sit in the folder a day before I need them.



Reliability over raw talent. I'd rather have a solid editor who never misses than a brilliant one I have to chase.



Volume without sloppiness. Captions timed correctly, no dead air, hook in the first frame, clean keying — every single time.



Range. You need to be fast on talking-head work and genuinely capable on motion graphics. One without the other doesn't work for this role.



Daily communication. A short end-of-day update on what shipped and what's next. Flag problems before they slip, not after.



Self-direction. I'll give you scripts, references, and brand direction. I'm not art-directing every cut.



Good enough English to follow scripts, catch context, and time captions accurately.



Stable internet and a machine that can handle daily motion-graphics work.



Tools

Strong in CapCut Pro and/or Premiere Pro. After Effects or equivalent motion skills is required for the daily promo video. Bonus: Figma or Photoshop for overlays, mockups, and thumbnails, plus experience editing tech/software or app-demo content.



Nice to have

Experience with high-volume creator or agency workflows



Prior work on SaaS or app promo creative



Understanding of what performs differently on TikTok vs. Reels



Google Drive / Dropbox / 
 pipeline experience



How to apply

Send the following — applications missing any of these get skipped:



Greenscreen example — one video where you keyed a subject over changing background visuals.



Talking-head examples — 2–3 short-form vertical UGC edits you personally edited.



Your best motion-graphics or product-promo edit — the one you'd show to win a job.



Real capacity answer — confirm you can deliver 4 videos a day including one premium edit, and list your current clients and commitments.



Process



Paid trial from my raw footage: one greenscreen, one talking head, one high-level promo edit



If it's a fit, we start a paid 30-day trial month at the full $1,500 salary, then move to long-term



Consistent delivery means raises and expanded scope as the accounts grow



I'm looking for someone to work with for years. If you show up every day and keep the queue full, this role is yours to keep.



Include the word "post-ready" in your message so I know you read this.

description:
META ADS & DIGITAL MARKETING SPECIALIST – BJJ / MARTIAL ARTS



We are an established Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu academy looking for an experienced Meta Ads & Digital Marketing Specialist to manage and grow our paid advertising.



We offer BJJ programs for kids and adults and are looking to significantly improve our local marketing while expanding into the sale of BJJ instructional content, online courses and other digital products.



This is a long-term role for someone who understands performance marketing, lead generation and conversions — not someone who simply knows how to boost posts.



WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON



1. Local BJJ Academy Marketing



You will develop and manage Meta campaigns designed to:



- Generate leads and bookings for trial BJJ classes

- Target parents for our kids' BJJ programs

- Target adults interested in starting BJJ

- Run local brand awareness campaigns

- Retarget website visitors and engaged audiences

- Improve trial bookings and ultimately convert prospects into members

- Test different audiences, offers, hooks and creatives



Our priority isn't simply generating cheap leads. We want quality prospects who actually book trials and have the potential to become paying members.



2. BJJ Instructional Content & Digital Products



We are also expanding into selling BJJ instructional content and digital products online.



You will help develop, launch and optimise campaigns for:



- Paid BJJ instructional content

- Online BJJ courses

- Digital products

- Lead magnets and free instructional content

-
 list acquisition

- Prospecting campaigns

- Retargeting campaigns

- Sales campaigns

- Funnel optimisation

- Scaling profitable campaigns



Unlike our academy advertising, this side of the business will target a national and international BJJ audience.



Experience successfully marketing online courses, instructionals or other digital products is therefore highly valued.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



- Create, manage and optimise Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertising campaigns

- Develop campaign structures and testing strategies

- Research and build appropriate audiences

- Set up prospecting and retargeting campaigns

- Develop advertising angles and offers

- Write compelling ad copy, headlines and hooks

- Work with our existing video and photo content to develop ads

- Advise us on what new creative content needs to be filmed

- Test different creatives, copy, audiences and offers

- Monitor CPL, CTR, CPM, CPA, ROAS and conversion rates

- Optimise campaigns based on actual performance data

- Track leads through to trial bookings and memberships

- Help develop and optimise digital product funnels

- Provide clear weekly reporting showing what is working, what isn't and what should be tested next



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You MUST have proven experience managing Meta Ads for lead generation and/or digital product sales.



Experience marketing any of the following is highly desirable:



- Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu

- Martial arts

- Gyms and fitness businesses

- Membership businesses

- Local service businesses

- Online courses

- Digital products

- Coaching or education businesses



Knowledge of BJJ or martial arts would be a major advantage.



WE WANT SOMEONE WHO UNDERSTANDS THE NUMBERS



We are looking for someone who thinks strategically.



We don't want someone who simply launches campaigns and leaves them running.



You should be comfortable analysing the entire customer acquisition journey and identifying where a campaign or funnel is failing.



For example:



Low hook rate → Creative problem



Good engagement but low CTR → Messaging/offer problem



Good CTR but poor lead conversion → Landing page/funnel problem



Lots of leads but few trial bookings → Lead quality or follow-up problem



Trials but poor membership conversion → Offer/sales process problem



For digital products, we also want someone who understands CPA, ROAS, conversion rates, retargeting and scaling profitable campaigns.



HOURS



Initially approximately 10–15 hours per week, with the opportunity for additional hours as our digital instructional business grows.



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term position who can grow with the business.



HOW TO APPLY



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word "BJJ".



Applications that do not start with BJJ may not be considered. This is so we know you have actually read the entire job description.



Then please tell us:



1. Your experience managing Meta Ads

2. Examples of campaigns you have personally managed

3. Your typical monthly ad spend managed

4. Results you've achieved — CPL, CPA, ROAS, etc.

5. Your experience generating leads for local businesses

6. Any experience with gyms, martial arts or membership businesses

7. Your experience selling online courses, instructionals or digital products

8. How you approach creative testing

9. How you determine when to scale, modify or stop a campaign

10. Your hourly rate and weekly availability



We're looking for someone who can become an important part of our marketing team and help us grow both our physical BJJ academies and our digital BJJ instructional business.

How we work

You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review.



This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code.



What you will do

- Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely.

- Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable.

- Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps.



Requirements

- Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely).

- Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself.

- Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input).

- Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow.

- Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders.

- Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday.



Nice to have

- AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features).

- Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience.



Trial (before any production access)

We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront.



You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep.

2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it?

3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code.

4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith?

5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records?

6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work.

- You ship AI output without verification.

- You cannot describe your workflow concretely.

- You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.

title: AI Growth Builder & Outbound Marketer (we build our own): property tech + new SaaS, remote
description:
AI Growth Builder and Outbound Marketer (global outreach), remote



The short version

We are a European property-tech group, and we are building something bigger. We need someone who uses AI to reach the right people in every market and turns that reach into real action on our platforms: agents listing their properties and getting viewings booked, agencies coming on board. Think AI-driven
, AI calling, and social outreach that gets people to like and share, country by country, in the local language. Important: we build and own our systems. We are not looking for someone who rents a pile of subscriptions, we want someone who builds the engine with us so we own it and reuse it. On top of that, you can pick up the broader marketing work too: content, social, basic SEO, paid, analytics.



Who we are

We run several live rental and property platforms in the European market on one shared codebase, plus a new SaaS for the staffing and recruitment sector. We move fast, we test thoroughly, and we reward people who prove results.



How we work (important)

- We build and own our tools. We prefer building over renting. Less vendor lock-in, more control, and everything we build we reuse across our platforms.

- That means working at the level of APIs, your own scripts, and your own automations, not clicking together a stack of expensive closed services.

- You build it once, we own it, and it keeps paying off across every channel and every country.



What you will do (the core)

- Build AI-powered, multi-channel outreach that we own and that scales worldwide, market by market:
 at volume, AI calling, social, and WhatsApp where it fits.

- For the property platform: reach real estate agents in every market and bring them onto the platform, listing their properties and getting viewings booked. The AI calls and messages carry one clear call to action: visit the site and get started.

- For the SaaS: reach staffing and recruitment agencies and get them on board and active in the same way.

- It is one engine for both products. You build it once and it runs for property and for staffing, country by country.

- Make it work in any language. Build a reliable localization approach so the outreach reads native in each market, using AI translation with quality control and native review where it matters. Rough machine translation does not cut it; the message has to feel local, not foreign.

- Drive social amplification: get agents and agencies to follow, like, and share our content, so reach compounds.

- Build the lead data, sequences, and automations yourself, and keep them deliverable and legal in every market you touch: GDPR in Europe, anti-spam laws such as CAN-SPAM, and local rules on
 and automated calling. Warmed domains, clear opt-out, and consent where it is required. Compliance and deliverability are part of the job, not an afterthought.

- Measure everything: replies, signups, activations, and double down on what works.



What you will do (the bonus, all-round)

- Content and social management, basic SEO, paid campaigns, simple design, reporting.



How you build it (we like builders, not renters)

- Comfortable wiring up LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) in your own workflows.

- Comfortable with self-hostable automation (for example n8n) and your own scripts over closed SaaS where it makes sense.

- Can build your own lead data, localization, and outreach pipeline instead of depending on one paid platform.

- For AI calling, you wire telephony and voice models yourself rather than relying on a closed black box.

If you already build your own automations instead of renting them, tell us. That is exactly who we want.



Who you are

- You think in systems and you build and own them.

- You have grown something real and can show it, with a number.

- You are comfortable with volume, testing, and iteration.

- You write clear English, and you have a proven way to make outreach read natively in many other languages (AI localization with quality control, native review where it matters). You do not rely on rough machine translation.

- You respect the law in each country you reach into, and you treat compliance as part of doing it well, not a brake. You know that automated calling in particular is tightly regulated and you handle it carefully, market by market.

- You are self-starting and reliable, and you keep brands safe (no spammy shortcuts that get domains blacklisted).



The deal

- Remote, full-time preferred. We start at a fair entry rate and raise it quickly for people who prove results.

- We test with a small paid task first, then move fast for the right person.

- As we scale this across both products and more markets, there is room for it to grow into more than one role.



How to apply (please read)

1. Start your message with the word GROWTH so I know you read this.

2. In a few lines, answer this: how would you reach 10,000 real estate agents in one country using AI, end to end, how would you keep it legal and deliverable there (think GDPR, anti-spam, and rules on automated calling), how would you make the outreach read natively in that country's language, and which parts would you build yourself versus rent?

3. Add one example of something you have grown, with a number.

Applications that skip these get less attention. We reply to serious ones quickly.

title: Shopify Post Purchase CRO Specialist
description:
Who We Are:



At Escend Media, we help D2C brands implement retention strategies that increase profit and drive customer retention. We want to be the ‘who’ behind
s that people ask ‘dannngg, who designed that’.



What We Do:

We help 7 and 8 figure ecommerce businesses develop, optimize and scale their owned media marketing efforts. Whether they are just looking to start
 marketing, they need to really refine what they are currently doing or they need someone to take
 marketing off their shoulders, we’re here to help them so that they can focus on running the business.



Our clients are leaders in their industry and have built strong relationships with the customers they serve. Our job is to ensure that their brand image stays consistent online and offline and, more importantly, that their business is growing.





Summary of The Position:



The Shopify Post Purchase CRO Specialist is responsible for the strategic implementation and optimization of post-purchase upsell funnels, primarily utilizing platforms like Aftersell. This role focuses on enhancing Average Order Value (AOV) and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) for Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) e-commerce brands by creating highly relevant and effective post-purchase offers. The specialist will manage the full lifecycle of implementation, from strategic planning and A/B testing to performance monitoring and continuous optimization, ensuring seamless integration and alignment with brand objectives.



Responsibilities:



• Implement and manage post-purchase upsell funnels using platforms such as Aftersell, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives to increase AOV and CLTV.

• Conduct systematic A/B testing across various elements including product selection, offer and pricing structures, pricing angles, copywriting, psychological angles, user interface (UI) optimization, and customer segmentation.

• Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Acceptance Rate, AOV Lift, Incremental Profit/Session, and Upsell Conversion Rate, optimizing for Revenue Per Visitor (RPV) and Profit Per Visitor (PPV).

• Ensure technical and creative requirements are met for all implementations, including fulfillment safety (e.g., 'Order on Hold' feature), mobile responsiveness, brand consistency, and effective inventory management.

• Collaborate with marketing and design teams to ensure brand consistency and compelling offer presentation.

• Identify and avoid common pitfalls such as the 'Wall of Text' error and the 'Irrelevance' trap, focusing on clear value propositions and relevant offers.

• Leverage customer data, loyalty programs, and other add-ons to enhance post-purchase strategies and maximize incremental revenue.

• Continuously refine and improve post-purchase strategies based on performance data and evolving market trends.



Our Culture:



• No one is bigger than the team

• We don’t make excuses, we take responsibility

• Innovate everywhere

• Communicate. Communicate. Communicate. We have a culture of open communication.



Required Skills:



• Proven experience in implementing and optimizing post-purchase upsell strategies, preferably with platforms like Aftersell.

• Strong understanding of e-commerce metrics and their impact on business growth (AOV, CLTV, ROAS, RPV, PPV).

• Demonstrated expertise in A/B testing methodologies and data-driven optimization.

• Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to quality assurance in all implementations.

• Knowledge of mobile UI/UX best practices for e-commerce.

• Ability to analyze performance data and translate insights into actionable strategies.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly.

• Experience with project management software (e.g., Clickup) is a plus.

• Proactive approach with a sense of urgency and purpose in daily tasks.



Perks:

- Flexible working hours

- Remote working

- Room to grow - we're an early stage start up with a proven track record

- Competitive compensation

- Work with some amazing brands



This Role Is Perfect for You If…



- You love working as a team.

- You are a self-starter.

- You can work under pressure

- You have exceptional communication skills

- You are results/outcome driven.

- You have a ‘can-do’ attitude. If “that’s not my job” isn’t in your vocabulary, you’ll fit in great!



This Role is NOT the Right Fit For You If You Are…

- A ‘me first’ type of person

- Not a self-starter.

- Not a ‘people person’

- Problem driven, not solution oriented. If you complain about problems/issues/bottlenecks, without proposing a solution, this is not for you.

- Looking for a typical 9-5. If you hate Mondays, this is not for you. We’re a mission-driven company who are all about changing the lives and businesses that we work with. If we have something that needs to get done, we’ll have all hands on deck. Sometimes you might have to work late but sometimes you’ll get the afternoon off, it’s not all work no play, but we’re here to help business grow!

title: Remote Appointment Setter
description:
Appointment Setter – Circle of Greatness

Location: Remote |



Circle of Greatness is seeking a high-performing, results-driven Appointment Setter to join our elite team. This role is built for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, executes consistently, and is ready to be a driving force behind our sales success.



We’re not looking for someone who needs hand-holding—we need an operator who adapts quickly, stays focused, and performs at a high level every single day.



Key Responsibilities

-Make 300 outbound dials per day through our dialer system to engage leads and book qualified appointments.

-Consistently hit daily/weekly performance KPIs for booked calls and conversions.

-Collaborate with closers and leadership to ensure smooth handoffs and elite client experience.

-Work across multiple offers and campaigns with adaptability and precision.

-Maintain accurate CRM records, tracking outreach activity, responses, and call outcomes.

-Apply coaching quickly—our pace requires speed, discipline, and a growth mindset.

-Navigate and leverage tech tools effectively, including:

-CRM software (proficient)

-Slack (comfortable or quick learner)

-General tech-savviness to operate multiple platforms



What We Expect

-Proven experience in appointment setting, inside sales, cold calling, or outbound SDR roles.

-Strong verbal and written communication skills.

-Coachability, discipline, and a commitment to personal/professional growth.

-Ability to think fast, handle objections, and adapt in real time.

-A performance-first mentality and the grit to meet metrics every day.

-Self-starter attitude—this role rewards execution, not supervision.



Compensation Structure & Growth Path



Contractor Role Clarification

-This position is offered as an independent contractor role, not as a traditional employee position. 

-Compensation is fully performance-based and tied directly to results generated through appointments (“sets”) created by the setter.

-Contractors are responsible for managing their own taxes, benefits, and legal obligations in accordance with local regulations.



Compensation Structure — From Day 1



Commission Structure

-Earn 3% commission on collected cash from deals closed through appointments (“sets”) generated by the setter, up to $100,000 collected cash per month.

-Once a setter reaches $100,000 in collected cash during a calendar month, the commission rate increases to 4% on ALL collected cash generated during that month.



Performance Bonus

Setters may also qualify for an additional monthly performance bonus:



$2,000 bonus once the setter reaches $75,000 in collected cash during the calendar month.

Bonus qualification resets on the 1st day of each new month.

Qualified bonuses will be paid during the normal mid-month payroll schedule following the completed month.



Growth Opportunity

- This compensation structure is designed to reward high performance and provide scalable earning potential based on production, consistency, and contribution to the sales organization.





This Role Is For You If…

You want to join a fast-moving, high-impact team that rewards results.



You’re committed to earning what you’re worth—and backing it up with consistent action.



You thrive in a dynamic environment and bring high energy daily.



You want to grow long-term inside a mission-driven business that transforms lives.



This isn’t just another sales job—this is a launchpad for long-term career growth inside a movement that’s scaling fast.

title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property-tech, remote)
description:
Title:

AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property-tech, remote)



Role

We are looking for a strong, reliable engineer who likes to move fast with AI tools and still ships carefully. We care heavily about clear communication, good decisions, and a clean trial result.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We maintain a long-running Laravel application with Blade, Vue 2, Bootstrap, and tenant-scoped data patterns. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



How we work

We use an AI-assisted development workflow. You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review.



This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code.



What you will do

- Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely.

- Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable.

- Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps.



Requirements

- Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely).

- Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself.

- Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input).

- Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow.

- Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders.

- Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday.



Nice to have

- AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features).

- Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience.



Trial (before any production access)

We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront.



You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep.

2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it?

3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code.

4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith?

5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records?

6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work.

- You ship AI output without verification.

- You cannot describe your workflow concretely.

- You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.

title: Shopify Post Purchase CRO Specialist
description:
Who We Are:



At Escend Media, we help D2C brands implement retention strategies that increase profit and drive customer retention. We want to be the ‘who’ behind
s that people ask ‘dannngg, who designed that’.



What We Do:

We help 7 and 8 figure ecommerce businesses develop, optimize and scale their owned media marketing efforts. Whether they are just looking to start
 marketing, they need to really refine what they are currently doing or they need someone to take
 marketing off their shoulders, we’re here to help them so that they can focus on running the business.



Our clients are leaders in their industry and have built strong relationships with the customers they serve. Our job is to ensure that their brand image stays consistent online and offline and, more importantly, that their business is growing.





Summary of The Position:



The Shopify Post Purchase CRO Specialist is responsible for the strategic implementation and optimization of post-purchase upsell funnels, primarily utilizing platforms like Aftersell. This role focuses on enhancing Average Order Value (AOV) and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) for Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) e-commerce brands by creating highly relevant and effective post-purchase offers. The specialist will manage the full lifecycle of implementation, from strategic planning and A/B testing to performance monitoring and continuous optimization, ensuring seamless integration and alignment with brand objectives.



Responsibilities:



• Implement and manage post-purchase upsell funnels using platforms such as Aftersell, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives to increase AOV and CLTV.

• Conduct systematic A/B testing across various elements including product selection, offer and pricing structures, pricing angles, copywriting, psychological angles, user interface (UI) optimization, and customer segmentation.

• Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Acceptance Rate, AOV Lift, Incremental Profit/Session, and Upsell Conversion Rate, optimizing for Revenue Per Visitor (RPV) and Profit Per Visitor (PPV).

• Ensure technical and creative requirements are met for all implementations, including fulfillment safety (e.g., 'Order on Hold' feature), mobile responsiveness, brand consistency, and effective inventory management.

• Collaborate with marketing and design teams to ensure brand consistency and compelling offer presentation.

• Identify and avoid common pitfalls such as the 'Wall of Text' error and the 'Irrelevance' trap, focusing on clear value propositions and relevant offers.

• Leverage customer data, loyalty programs, and other add-ons to enhance post-purchase strategies and maximize incremental revenue.

• Continuously refine and improve post-purchase strategies based on performance data and evolving market trends.



Our Culture:



• No one is bigger than the team

• We don’t make excuses, we take responsibility

• Innovate everywhere

• Communicate. Communicate. Communicate. We have a culture of open communication.



Required Skills:



• Proven experience in implementing and optimizing post-purchase upsell strategies, preferably with platforms like Aftersell.

• Strong understanding of e-commerce metrics and their impact on business growth (AOV, CLTV, ROAS, RPV, PPV).

• Demonstrated expertise in A/B testing methodologies and data-driven optimization.

• Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to quality assurance in all implementations.

• Knowledge of mobile UI/UX best practices for e-commerce.

• Ability to analyze performance data and translate insights into actionable strategies.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly.

• Experience with project management software (e.g., Clickup) is a plus.

• Proactive approach with a sense of urgency and purpose in daily tasks.



Perks:

- Flexible working hours

- Remote working

- Room to grow - we're an early stage start up with a proven track record

- Competitive compensation

- Work with some amazing brands



This Role Is Perfect for You If…



- You love working as a team.

- You are a self-starter.

- You can work under pressure

- You have exceptional communication skills

- You are results/outcome driven.

- You have a ‘can-do’ attitude. If “that’s not my job” isn’t in your vocabulary, you’ll fit in great!



This Role is NOT the Right Fit For You If You Are…

- A ‘me first’ type of person

- Not a self-starter.

- Not a ‘people person’

- Problem driven, not solution oriented. If you complain about problems/issues/bottlenecks, without proposing a solution, this is not for you.

- Looking for a typical 9-5. If you hate Mondays, this is not for you. We’re a mission-driven company who are all about changing the lives and businesses that we work with. If we have something that needs to get done, we’ll have all hands on deck. Sometimes you might have to work late but sometimes you’ll get the afternoon off, it’s not all work no play, but we’re here to help business grow!

Your main responsibility will be making outbound calls to homeowners, introducing our roofing services, asking basic qualifying questions, identifying potential opportunities, and setting appointments when appropriate.

title: Web Developer
description:
Role Summary

The Website Developer is a part-time, ongoing contract position responsible for the day-to-day maintenance, troubleshooting, updates, and enhancements across Cornerstone's web properties. This role reports directly to the Executive Assistant and works in close coordination with the CEO. The developer is expected to take direction, deliver on deadlines, maintain transparent communication, and operate fully within Cornerstone's systems — not their own.



Important — Please Read Before Applying

This role is managed day-to-day by a female Executive Assistant who has full authority to assign tasks, set priorities, request revisions, and approve deliverables. The developer must be fully comfortable receiving direction, feedback, and creative decisions from a female supervisor. This is a non-negotiable condition of this role. Candidates who are not comfortable working under female leadership will not be considered.



Platforms & Technology

Candidates must have hands-on, working experience with the following. Proficiency will be evaluated during the skills assessment.

Required

WordPress — including page editor access, plugin management, and backend administration

Elementor — widget-level editing, form configuration via Actions After Submit, and troubleshooting within the editor (not just Site Settings)

WooCommerce — product pages, order notification templates, category pages, and checkout configuration

WP Mail SMTP — authentication setup, OAuth configuration, and
 deliverability troubleshooting

GoDaddy — hosting account access and domain management

Squarespace — site editing, mobile responsiveness, and content updates

Google Workspace — Gmail, Drive, Docs, and Sheets for day-to-day communication and reporting

Strongly Preferred

SEO best practices — alt text, meta tags, image optimization (WebP), Google Search Console

Mobile UI / responsiveness — cross-browser and cross-device testing

Figma — for design review and approval workflows before touching the live site

Third-party CRM integrations — iframe-embedded forms and routing configurations outside WordPress

Zapier and/or 
 — automation workflows





Responsibilities

Website Maintenance & Updates

Perform ongoing maintenance and enhancements across all three active websites as directed

Implement product page updates including images, descriptions, specs, and category assignments

Ensure all form routing is correctly configured — quote forms must route to the correct department
 addresses at all times; any misconfiguration must be flagged and resolved immediately

Maintain correct
 notification templates in WooCommerce — no personal
 addresses should appear in any order or refund notification template

Fix mobile UI issues, including navigation, filter display, and layout conflicts between desktop and mobile views

Connect buttons, blog posts, and pages to the correct internal links as directed

Audit and resolve image issues (missing images, mismatched product photos, display errors)

Ensure the mega menu and navigation are functional across all device types

Communication & Reporting

Provide a daily end-of-day (EOD) progress report via
 or agreed communication channel — format to be provided by the Executive Assistant

Send visual previews (screenshots or screen recordings) of work completed before marking a task done

Seek explicit approval before publishing any changes to the live site; work must be reviewed and signed off before going live

Flag issues, blockers, or scope changes immediately — do not wait until a deadline to communicate a problem

Respond to messages within the agreed response window; the company should never have to follow up more than once on an outstanding question

Credentials & Data Security

All Cornerstone-related
 routing, form notifications, and backend access must flow through company-designated
 addresses only — never a personal
 address

Never change account passwords, login credentials, or access permissions for any Cornerstone-owned account without explicit written authorization from the CEO or Executive Assistant

Provide full login credentials for every platform, plugin, tool, or account you configure or access on Cornerstone's behalf — upon request, all access must be transferred immediately and completely

Cornerstone's proprietary customer data, order information, and business communications are confidential. They must not be stored in, routed through, or accessible via any personal account belonging to the developer or any third party

Upon termination of the engagement, all access must be removed and all credentials must be transferred to Cornerstone within 24 hours

Sprint Delivery & Deadlines

Work will be organized in sprint cycles with hard deadlines agreed upon at the start of each sprint

Deliverables are considered complete only when the pages or features are live on the production site, have passed client QA, and have been signed off by the Executive Assistant or CEO

Missed sprint deadlines without prior written notice are a violation of this agreement and may result in withheld milestone payment and/or termination of the engagement

If a deadline is at risk, the developer must notify the Executive Assistant at least 48 hours in advance with a written explanation and a revised completion date





Non-Negotiable Requirements

These are disqualifying conditions. Applications that do not meet all of the following will not move forward.



You must personally perform the work. Cornerstone must know exactly who is working on our websites at all times. If you are a studio or agency, you must clearly identify who the individual developer is and confirm that person — not a proxy — will be doing the hands-on work.

You must be comfortable taking direction from a female supervisor. The Executive Assistant has full authority over this role. Pushback on her authority, refusal to follow her instructions, or disrespectful communication toward her is grounds for immediate termination.

You must adhere to deadlines. Repeated late deliveries — even without formal notice — are grounds for non-payment of the affected milestone and termination.

All work-related communications, customer data, and
 routing must stay within Cornerstone's systems at all times. Using a personal
 address for any Cornerstone-related correspondence is not permitted.

You must transfer all credentials and access immediately upon request. Changing a password, removing access, or in any way locking Cornerstone out of an account you manage on their behalf will result in immediate termination and may be subject to legal action.

You must complete a DISC personality assessment as part of the hiring process before receiving an offer.





Hiring Process

Candidates who meet the qualifications above will go through the following steps:

1.  Application review — portfolio and relevant experience

2.  10-minute screening call with the Executive Assistant

3.  Skills assessment — WordPress/Elementor troubleshooting case study (30–45 min)

4.  DISC personality assessment

5.  Final interview with the CEO





How to Apply

To be considered, please submit the following:

- A brief introduction explaining your background and why this role is a fit

- Links to two or three websites you have built or maintained — ideally on WordPress and/or Squarespace

- A short 1-2 minute video explaining how you handle a situation where a client gives you feedback you disagree with

- Your expected hourly rate or preferred compensation structure



Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

title: Appointment Setter
description:

- Primary goal: book appointments with qualified leads for the appropriate team member.

- Accurately update lead information, call outcomes, and notes in the CRM.

- Applicants without cold calling experience will not be considered.
