title: Operations Execution Coordinator
description:
Operations Execution Lead  

Compensation: $1,400/month  



Mission  

Turn priorities into finished results.  



SteelSafe operates self-storage properties across the United States. There is always work that needs to get done: property issues, vendors, purchases, projects, recurring operations, and problems that cross multiple people or systems.   



Your job is to own that execution.  



Some work you will do yourself. Some you will delegate to team members, boots on the ground, or vendors.  



Either way, you own the result.  



When leadership hands you an outcome, we should be able to forget about it until you come back with the finished result.  





Operating Rules  

Own the result. Do not pass problems.   

Assigning is not completing. Delegated work is still your responsibility.   

Asana is the system of record. If it is not in Asana, it does not exist.   

No proof = not done.   

Move fast. Small problems get expensive when they sit.   

No silent failures. Surface risks early with a recovery plan.   

Bring solutions. If leadership must d
, bring the options and your recommendation.   

Close loops. Nobody should have to ask, “Whatever happened with that?”   

Build better systems. The better you get, the less time the same work should require.   



What You Own  



1. Property & Rent-Ready Execution   



Drive property work from problem to verified completion.   



Examples:   

Get unavailable units back to Rent-Ready.   

Coordinate cleanouts.   

Get doors, locks, leaks, roofs, gates, cameras, fencing, weeds, trash, signs, electrical issues, and other property problems resolved.   

Coordinate vendors, quotes, scheduling, execution, and proof.   



The process is: Problem → Owner → Quote → Approval if needed → Schedule → Execute → Verify → Close    



Every unavailable unit must have a reason, owner, next action, and deadline.   



Do not report that a unit is stuck.   



Get it unstuck.  



2. BOTG & Vendor Management  



Own the people who execute work locally.  

Find and hire BOTG and vendors.  

Give clear scopes and deadlines.   

Get quotes.   

Follow up.   

Verify work.  

Correct poor work.  

Replace underperformers.   

Maintain backup options.  



 “I asked them” is not a result.  



The work being completed correctly is the result.  



3. Projects & Procurement  



Own independent projects from idea to completion.  



Examples include:  

Source and purchase supplies or equipment.  

Order signs, locks, parts, cameras, and materials.  

Research and negotiate vendors or services.  

Sell unused assets.  

Coordinate property improvement projects.  

Build new operational processes.  

Complete one-off projects leadership assigns.  



You are expected to figure out the path forward without needing step-by-step direction.  



4. Operational Problem Resolution  



When a customer or company issue requires operational action, own the execution.  



Investigate the problem, determine what needs to happen, coordinate the people involved, and drive it through resolution.  



Leadership owns unusual policy, legal, financial, or strategic decisions.  



Once the decision is made, you own getting it done.  

  



What Winning Looks Like  

Work gets completed on time.  

Projects do not stall.  

Rent-Ready units do not sit because nobody followed through.  

Vendors and BOTG are held accountable.  

Problems are surfaced before deadlines are missed.  

Completed work is actually complete.  

Asana reflects reality.  

Recurring work becomes simpler and requires less manual effort.  



This Role Is a Fit If You  

Are a doer.  

Take ownership without reminders.  

Finish what you start.  

Can manage a small team and still execute personally.  

Can take an unfamiliar project and figure it out.  

Follow up relentlessly.  

Make good decisions independently.  

Keep many moving pieces organized.  

Communicate problems early.  

Hold vendors and teammates accountable.  

Care about details and proof.  

Enjoy turning messy work into reliable systems.  



Own the result, not the clock. Do what it takes to get the job done. Then improve the system so the same result takes less time and effort next time.

title: # Insurance Servicing Virtual Assistant (P&C) — Direct Hire, Full-Time
description:
# Insurance Servicing Virtual Assistant (P&C) — Direct Hire, Full-Time



**Company:** P3 Insurance Solutions (independent insurance agency, USA)

**Type:** Full-time, long-term, work-from-home

**Salary:** $600/month to start, with room to grow based on performance

**Schedule:** Full-time, aligned to US Central Time business hours

**Raises:** Annual, based on performance



---



## About us



We're an independent insurance agency based in the United States, writing personal and commercial lines. We're a small, tight team that values people who take ownership, communicate clearly, and stick around for the long haul. This is a direct role with us, not through a BPO or agency. You work with us, you're paid by us, and there's no middleman taking a cut of your worth.



## Who we're looking for



We want someone who already knows insurance. If you've worked a US insurance account at a BPO or call center, handled P&C servicing, or supported a US agency before, you're exactly who we're trying to reach. You already understand the vocabulary, the pace, and the systems, and you're ready to go direct and earn more than a BPO pays you.



If that's you, we'd love to talk. We're offering a clear step up from BPO wages, a stable long-term seat, and a team that treats you like part of the agency instead of a headset in a queue.



## What you'll do



This is a real customer-servicing role. Day to day you'll be:



- Preparing quotes and rating new business and renewals in our raters and carrier systems, for a licensed producer to review and present to the client

- Processing policy change and endorsement requests in our agency management system

- Running renewals through the system and updating policy details

- Catching and syncing carrier downloads

- Issuing auto ID cards and certificates of insurance

- Preparing and tracking cancellation notices, and checking status on carrier sites

- Logging and updating claim notices from carriers

- Pulling billing and payment status for clients

- Answering incoming phone calls, fielding the agency line, taking messages, and directing calls to the right person

- Following up with insureds by phone and
 to collect missing documents and information

- General data entry and file management in the system, keeping records clean and current



You'll be the engine that keeps servicing moving so our clients feel taken care of and fast.



## What this role does NOT include



You'll prepare quotes and ratings, but to keep everyone compliant with US insurance regulations, this role does **not** involve presenting quotes to clients, comparing or recommending products, advising clients on coverage or their insurance needs, interpreting policies, soliciting or selling, or binding coverage. You do the prep work, and a licensed producer reviews it, advises the client, and closes. Anything that crosses into advice, recommendation, or a bind gets routed to our licensed team. We'll train you on exactly where that line sits. Understanding and respecting this boundary is part of the job.



## Requirements



- Prior insurance experience (US P&C account, agency, or BPO insurance campaign strongly preferred)

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Comfortable on the phone with US clients

- Familiarity with an agency management system (NowCerts, AMS360, EZLynx, HawkSoft, Applied, or similar) and ACORD forms is a big plus

- Reliable computer, stable internet, and a quiet work environment

- Able to work US Central Time business hours

- Organized, detail-oriented, and dependable

- Long-term mindset. We're building a team, not filling a gap.



## Pay and terms



- $600/month to start, paid directly to you (no BPO, no commission structure)

- Annual raises based on your performance

- Long-term, full-time position



## How to apply



Please read carefully, because this is how we screen for people who pay attention.



1. Start your application with the word **BLUEBIRD** at the very top so we know you read the full post.

2. Tell us in a few sentences about your insurance experience: what lines you worked, which systems you've used, and whether it was agency-side or BPO.

3. Tell us your English comfort level on the phone with US clients.

4. Confirm you can work US Central Time hours.

5. Complete this short DISC personality assessment and include your result (your DISC type) in your application: 
 — this step is required to move forward.



Applications that don't start with the code word, don't mention insurance experience, or don't include a DISC result won't be reviewed. We're looking for someone sharp, and this is the first test.



We read every qualified application and reply to the ones that fit. Thanks for taking the time.

description:
Law Firm Billing & Finance Specialist — A+ English Writing and Speaking Skills Required



U.S.-based law firm seeks a detail-oriented, financially sharp specialist to manage invoicing, timekeeping, collections, and take on light fractional-CFO responsibilities. The law firm is virtual and works with corporate clients and brokers in the commercial and residential real estate industries. This is a great fit for someone who loves numbers, has real QuickBooks Online experience, and is comfortable being the person who keeps the firm’s finances on track, not just the biller.



RESPONSIBILITIES — Success in this role looks like:

• Billing & invoicing: monthly timesheets and client invoices go out in Clio on time, every time

• Vendor payments: vendor invoices get paid on time, with clean, up-to-date records

• Collections: outstanding balances get proactive follow-up, and overdue invoices keep trending down instead of piling up

• Financial oversight: the bookkeeper’s monthly numbers get a sharp second look, the annual budget stays current without being asked, and QuickBooks Online is always audit-ready

• Trust accounting: IOLTA stays airtight — reconciled, compliant, and zero surprises

• Closings: support the paralegal to ensure commercial and residential closing ledgers balance, settlement statements get a genuine second set of eyes before they go out, and nothing slips through the cracks from contract to closing



REQUIREMENTS — You’ll thrive in this role if:

• QuickBooks Online: is second nature — you reconcile accounts and read a P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement without hand-holding

• Trust/IOLTA accounting: rules and reconciliation for law firms aren’t new to you

• Budgeting: you’ve built and managed one before, and you can explain the “why” behind a variance, not just report the number

• Clio: you’re comfortable invoicing and billing matters in it (or a similar legal practice management platform)

• Collaboration: you’re comfortable working alongside a paralegal on live transactions under closing deadlines

• Excel: your spreadsheet skills are strong — formulas, formatting, and basic reporting

• Written & Spoken English: is excellent — you’ll be the one talking balances with clients and financials with the attorney

• Background: you’ve supported bookkeeping, controller, or fractional-CFO functions before, ideally for a U.S.-based company or law firm

• Discretion: financial information is handled confidentially

• Curiosity: you’re excited to use AI and tech to make financial processes faster and more accurate



BENEFITS

The firm will pay a 13th month bonus (equal to the average of one month’s pay). Nine paid holidays a year.



HOURS PER WEEK

This role will be expected to work 20+ hours per week, Monday through Friday, with at least some hours overlapping 9:00am–6:00pm Eastern Standard Time. 



ADDITIONAL DETAILS

This job requires a high-speed, secure internet connection. You are expected to work from your own home.



HOW TO APPLY

To apply, please send your resume/CV highlighting your QuickBooks Online, budgeting, and trust accounting experience, a short cover letter, and your hourly pay requirement in USD.



Please use at least 7 Apply Points when applying.

title: Supply Chain Manager – E-Commerce Dropshipping (High Volume, 3,000+ SKUs)
description:
ABOUT US



We are U-S Limited, a fast-growing e-commerce company operating multiple successful dropshipping stores across different European markets. We run our own brands with 3,000+ active SKUs sourced from a wide network of suppliers and agents. We move serious volume, and the complexity of our supply chain grows every week — more suppliers, more invoices, constant price changes, and more moving parts. We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Manager who can take full control of this and protect our margins.



THE ROLE



This is a high-volume, high-responsibility role. You will own our entire supplier and product operation. You will manage multiple suppliers, stay on top of every invoice and price change, and make sure our 3,000+ SKUs are always priced correctly, in stock, and fulfilled on time. A big part of this role is dealing directly with suppliers — and that means being a strong, direct communicator who verifies everything, questions incorrect charges, and holds suppliers accountable instead of accepting whatever they send. We need someone who is comfortable pushing back and negotiating hard to protect our pricing and margins.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



- Manage relationships with multiple suppliers and agents across different product categories

- Communicate directly and firmly with suppliers — verify pricing, question errors, and hold them to their terms

- Negotiate hard on pricing, volume discounts, shipping costs, and better terms

- Track, verify, and reconcile all supplier invoices — catch errors, double charges, and incorrect pricing before they cost us money

- Monitor price increases across all SKUs, flag them proactively, and calculate the margin impact

- Keep our 3,000+ SKU catalog accurate — cost prices, supplier links, shipping times, and stock status

- Monitor supplier performance: shipping times, defect rates, stock availability, and reliability

- Identify and resolve stockouts, fulfillment delays, and quality issues quickly

- Handle multi-currency cost tracking and understand the impact of FX on our margins

- Build and improve internal processes and systems to manage the supply chain at high volume

- Work directly with the CEO on sourcing strategy, cost optimization, and scaling decisions

- Take ownership and think proactively — anticipate problems instead of reacting to them



HARD REQUIREMENTS



- Proven experience managing supply chain or supplier operations for a high-volume e-commerce or dropshipping business — this is not a role for beginners

- You are used to working with large revenues, large order volumes, and large SKU catalogs (3,000+ SKUs)

- Experience managing multiple suppliers / Chinese agents at the same time

- A strong, direct communicator and hard negotiator — you are comfortable pushing back, questioning charges, and holding suppliers accountable

- Strong with numbers — you can spot pricing errors instantly, calculate margin impact, and reconcile invoices accurately

- Highly organized and detail-oriented — nothing slips through the cracks

- Analytical, proactive, and able to make decisions independently

- Comfortable working directly with the CEO in a fast-moving environment

- Strong written English



NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)



- Experience with European dropshipping markets

- Familiarity with Shopify, supplier portals, and fulfillment systems

- Experience building spreadsheets / systems for cost tracking and supplier management



WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU



- Full-time remote role

- Direct collaboration with the CEO

- High ownership and real impact on company profitability

- Opportunity to grow into a senior operations or supply chain lead role

- Long-term position inside a fast-growing e-commerce business



HOW TO APPLY



To apply, send us:



- Your resume

- A short summary (3–5 sentences) of your experience — include how many suppliers, how many SKUs, and what order/revenue volume you managed

- Proof of your experience and results (cost savings you achieved, systems you built, supplier issues you resolved, screenshots, case studies, or data)

- A short explanation of how you stay on top of hundreds of invoices and constant price changes without losing control



Important: This role is for experienced, high-volume operators only. No proof = no answer. We do not respond to generic applications or applicants who cannot show real experience with serious volume — it wastes both your time and ours. To confirm you read the full post, include the word "ANCHOR" in your application.

 / Meta Ads Specialist who has previously generated mortgage leads for mortgage brokers, lenders, or loan officers in the United States.**

 and Instagram advertising to generate **qualified U.S. homebuyer mortgage leads — not simply cheap leads.**



### Previous U.S. Mortgage Experience Is Required



You should have previously managed Meta/Facebook campaigns for:

* Mortgage lenders

* Loan officers

* Residential home financing

* Homebuyer/purchase mortgage campaigns



Experience generating **purchase mortgage leads** is strongly preferred.



---



# PRIMARY OBJECTIVE



Build and manage a Meta advertising system that consistently generates qualified mortgage prospects.



Our initial target market is:



**New Jersey homebuyers who already have a signed purchase contract and expect to close within the next 1–90 days.**



Typical requested loan amount:



**$300,000–$2,000,000**



We care about **qualified mortgage opportunities**, not vanity metrics.

 and Instagram advertising campaigns

* Helping automate SMS/email follow-up

* Monitoring campaigns and controlling wasted ad spend

* Running A/B tests

* Providing clear weekly performance reports



---



# YOU MUST UNDERSTAND THE ENTIRE FUNNEL



**Ad → Lead → Qualified Lead → Appointment → Application → Closed Loan**



We are NOT looking for someone who simply knows how to operate Meta Ads Manager.



We want someone who understands **mortgage customer acquisition.**



---



# REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Please apply ONLY if you can check most of these boxes:



☐ Previous
/Meta Ads experience



☐ Previous experience generating leads for a **U.S. mortgage company, lender, broker, or loan officer**



☐ Experience with U.S. residential mortgage campaigns



☐ Understanding of Meta's rules applicable to housing/mortgage advertising

☐ Experience measuring cost per lead and cost per qualified lead



☐ Experience A/B testing creatives, hooks, copy, forms, and landing pages



☐ Strong analytical skills



☐ Strong written English



☐ Reliable internet and computer



☐ Able to work independently without constant supervision



---



# STRONG BONUS SKILLS



Experience with any of the following is valuable:



* GoHighLevel

* HubSpot

* Zapier

* Mortgage CRM systems

* SMS/email automation

* Google Analytics

* Google Ads

* Canva

* Landing-page builders

* Mortgage purchase campaigns

* Jumbo mortgages

* First-time homebuyer campaigns

* Realtor lead-generation partnerships



---



# HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS



Your performance will ultimately be measured on:



1. **Cost per lead**

2. **Cost per qualified mortgage lead**

3. **Lead-to-appointment conversion**

4. **Appointment-to-application conversion**

5. **Cost per mortgage application**

6. **Closed/funded loan attribution**

7. **Return on advertising spend**



A $20 lead that never qualifies is worth less to us than a $75 lead that becomes a serious mortgage applicant.



**Lead quality matters more than lead volume.**



---



# COMPENSATION



**Starting Rate: $7–$12 USD/hour**



We are willing to pay toward the higher end for someone who can demonstrate actual U.S. mortgage lead-generation results.



We would prefer to start part-time while we establish performance.



If you can consistently generate qualified mortgage opportunities at an acceptable acquisition cost, this can become a **long-term position with increased hours and compensation.**



---



# HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with:



**"I HAVE GENERATED U.S. MORTGAGE LEADS"**



Then answer ALL of the following:



### 1. Mortgage Experience



Which U.S. mortgage companies, brokers, lenders, or loan officers have you run
/Meta Ads for?

### 2. Results



For your best U.S. mortgage campaign, tell us:

* Number of leads:

* Average cost per lead:

* Number of qualified leads:

* Cost per qualified lead:

* Appointments generated:

* Applications generated:

* Closed loans, if tracked:

**You may remove or hide confidential client information.**



### 4. Purchase Mortgage Experience



Have you specifically generated leads from people looking to **purchase a home**, rather than refinance?



Explain the campaign and results.



### 5. Campaign Strategy



Assume we want to generate mortgage inquiries from:

 Lead → Qualified Lead → Appointment → Application → Closed Loan?**

 posts.**

We will prioritize candidates who can show documented results generating **U.S. mortgage leads through Meta advertising.**



The **$7–$12/hour range is appropriate for screening**, but I would not automatically reject someone asking $12–$15/hour if they can prove they have built profitable U.S. mortgage campaigns. Current PH postings show experienced mortgage/real-estate marketing talent around $7–$9/hour, while specialized Meta performance marketers are being advertised substantially higher. ([OnlineJobs][1])

 lead forms.

title: Senior Meta Media Buyer – Lead Generation / Direct Response
description:
We are looking for a high-level, full-time Meta Media Buyer to join our performance marketing team.



This is NOT a junior role, social media management position, or a job for someone who simply knows how to launch
 campaigns.



We are looking for someone who understands direct response marketing, lead generation, numbers, creative strategy and scaling — and who can take real ownership of performance.



ABOUT US



We are an established pay-per-lead agency operating primarily in the financial industry.



We generate leads through Meta Ads for financial/trading companies with their own sales and call-center teams.



Our campaigns run across multiple international markets including Italy, Spain, Sweden, Latin America and selected Middle Eastern markets.



The business, infrastructure, CRM, tracking systems, tools and creative resources are already in place.



Your job is to run, optimize and scale.



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



Launching and managing Meta Ads campaigns

Daily campaign monitoring and optimization

Scaling profitable campaigns

Managing meaningful advertising budgets

Controlling CPL while also monitoring lead quality

Analyzing campaign and CRM conversion data

Identifying performance problems and acting quickly

Developing and testing new campaign strategies

Competitor research

Researching winning concepts, hooks and advertising angles

Developing creative concepts and briefing our creative team

Identifying creative fatigue and requesting new variations

Managing multiple advertising accounts and Business Managers

Working with browser-profile management tools such as AdsPower or similar

Basic
 Lead Form / Zapier / CRM integrations

Troubleshooting campaign and lead-delivery issues

Communicating with our quality and creative managers

Taking ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do



IMPORTANT: We do not optimize only for the cheapest possible lead.



We monitor downstream lead quality and conversion status through our CRM. Your goal is to generate profitable, high-quality leads that our clients can convert and that allow us to continuously increase volume.



We want a MEDIA BUYER WHO THINKS — not a button pusher.



CREATIVE STRATEGY



We already have people who create images and videos.



However, the media buyer is expected to drive the creative strategy.



You should be able to analyze performance and say things such as:



“We need 5 new creatives around this angle.”



“This concept is working — let's create more variations.”



“This competitor is testing an interesting angle — let's develop our own version.”



The ability to personally create or edit creatives using our tools is a plus, but not required.



REQUIREMENTS



3+ years of hands-on Meta Ads experience

Personally managed at least $30,000+ per month in Meta ad spend

Strong lead-generation experience

Strong performance/direct-response marketing knowledge

Experience scaling campaigns with meaningful budgets

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Good understanding of creative testing and marketing psychology

Comfortable managing multiple ad accounts / Business Managers

Familiarity with AdsPower or similar tools

Good written and spoken English

Able to work independently

Available full-time and exclusively for our company



Experience in finance, trading, fintech or other financial lead-generation niches is a BIG PLUS, but not mandatory.



Experience with GoHighLevel, Zapier and CRM integrations is also a plus.



WORKING WITH US



This is a full-time, long-term and exclusive position.



We are not looking for someone simultaneously managing several other clients or another full-time job.



Our normal working week is Monday to Friday, primarily around European campaign hours.



We care much more about results and ownership than simply counting hours.



There may be quieter periods when campaigns are stable and other moments when something requires immediate attention. If something breaks or performance suddenly changes, we expect you to take ownership and help solve it.



Communication is mainly through chat, with occasional team calls, normally around once per week.



COMPENSATION & GROWTH



We offer a competitive fixed salary based on experience and proven ability.



After the initial evaluation/testing period, strong performers can also earn additional performance-based compensation.



The more profitable campaigns and volume you can successfully manage, the more opportunity you have to earn.



We are willing to pay very well for someone who is genuinely good.



We do NOT care about university degrees, fancy corporate titles or certificates.



We care about:



Skills. Numbers. Ownership. Speed. Judgment. Results.



HOW TO APPLY



Please do NOT send a generic copy-paste application.



Start your application with:



I READ THE FULL POST

How many years have you personally managed Meta Ads?

We’re Kids On Stage, an award-winning Los Angeles performing arts company offering theater classes, musical theater programs, camps, and enrichment experiences for children and teens since 1987.



We’re a small, close-knit team, and we’ve rarely let employees go. We value people who want to stay, contribute, and build trust, not just finish a few projects and move on. This role starts part-time, with the potential for the right person to grow into a full-time position within a year.



What we need your help with:



We have performances, rehearsals, and plenty of moments worth sharing. We need someone who can see the possibilities in that material and turn it into thoughtful, engaging content that connects with parents and supports enrollment.



You’ll own the process from beginning to end: d
 what to create and why, making it, publishing it, and checking whether it worked. This isn’t a strategy-only position or a role where you’ll simply wait for editing and design assignments.



Our goal is ambitious: make KOS the social media leader among our competitors within six months, then maintain that position. You’ll be responsible for planning how we get there and improving results along the way, while respecting our brand and understanding what KOS parents respond to and what they don’t.



Your work will include:



- Setting social media goals and d

- Automating reporting and tracking performance for KOS and our competitors

- Developing monthly content plans and original ideas

- Editing Reels and YouTube Shorts from supplied footage

- Writing hooks, captions, scripts, and calls to action

- Creating graphics, carousels, covers, testimonials, and enrollment posts

- Publishing and repurposing content across Instagram,
, and YouTube

What it’s like to work with us:



We care about the details, and we have high standards. You’ll work closely with several colleagues and directly with our CEO for design and Reel approvals.



We want you to bring ideas and explain your thinking. If you disagree with a direction, even the CEO’s, we want you to feel comfortable saying so respectfully and making your case. We don’t expect you to agree with everything. We do expect you to listen, handle feedback professionally, and follow through once a decision is made.



We expect around 20-25 hours of work per week, although some weeks may require more. For significant projects, you’ll propose a time budget, and we’ll discuss and approve it together.

title: Podcast & YouTube Producer / Content Repurposing Manager
description:
I am looking for a creative, reliable, and highly organized Podcast & YouTube Producer / Content Repurposing Manager for an ongoing part-time role.



I have an established library of podcast interviews and other content that I want to refresh, tighten, repackage, and repurpose for YouTube and podcast platforms.



Some older episodes are still highly relevant but may need stronger editing for today’s audience. For example, a 20-minute interview may be much stronger at 10–12 minutes if the unnecessary sections are removed and the main story is brought forward. Some are audio only; some are video and audio.



This role requires more than technical editing. I am looking for someone with strong editorial judgment and excellent copywriting skills.



Responsibilities



You may be responsible for:



Editing podcast audio and video

Tightening older episodes while preserving the speaker’s meaning and natural voice

Removing repetition, long pauses and sections that do not add value

Creating polished intros and outros

Preparing episodes for YouTube and podcast platforms

Writing strong episode titles

Writing descriptions, summaries and show notes

Writing promotional copy

Identifying strong hooks and key moments

Creating or coordinating thumbnails

Creating YouTube Shorts and social media clips

Adding captions and subtitles

Organizing content into playlists and categories

Optimizing content for search and discoverability

Reviewing older content and recommending how it can be repurposed

Helping create a consistent visual and editorial style

Reviewing analytics and identifying which topics, titles and formats perform best

Suggesting ways to improve reach, engagement and audience growth

Copywriting Is a Major Part of This Role



Strong written English is essential.



I do not want generic descriptions or titles that sound AI-generated.



You should be able to listen to an interview, understand what makes it interesting, and turn that into compelling copy that makes someone want to click, watch or listen.



For example:



Weak:

“Interview with Jane Smith about her life journey”



Stronger:

“Starting Over After Everything Changed: A Story of Resilience and Purpose”



You need to be able to find the real story inside the conversation.



You May Be a Good Fit If You:

Have excellent written and spoken English

Have experience editing podcasts and/or YouTube videos

Understand audience retention

Understand YouTube titles, thumbnails and basic SEO

Are a strong copywriter

Have good storytelling instincts

Can identify the strongest parts of a conversation

Can work independently once you understand the style and expectations

Are comfortable making recommendations

Are highly organized

Pay close attention to detail

Prefer clean, professional editing over excessive effects



Experience with interview-based podcasts, educational content, wellness, leadership, coaching or personal development is helpful but not required.



This Is Not the Right Role If:

You only provide basic technical editing

You rely entirely on AI for titles and descriptions

You need detailed instructions for every task

You are uncomfortable making editorial decisions

Your editing style focuses more on effects than improving the content itself

Ongoing Work



This is an ongoing part-time role.



There is a substantial library of existing content to work through, along with new content being created.



I am looking for someone who could potentially become a long-term member of my content team.



How to Apply



Please include:



A short introduction and your relevant experience.

Links to 2–3 podcasts or YouTube videos you have edited or produced.

Examples of titles, descriptions, show notes or promotional copy you personally wrote.

Tell me what makes a podcast episode interesting enough for someone to keep listening.

Tell me what you would look for when d
 how to turn a 20-minute interview into a stronger 10–15 minute episode.

Begin your application with the word "Motivation" so I know you read the full posting.



Please do not send a generic application.



I am much more interested in finding someone with strong judgment, communication skills and creative ability than receiving a long list of software programs you know how to use.

title: Email Designer – D2C E-Commerce Brand
description:
Summary

We’re looking for an
 Designer to join our retention marketing team and become the dedicated
 designer for our men’s belt brand.



You’ll work closely with our Head of Retention and the rest of the design team, creating campaigns and flows and helping us continuously improve the quality of our
 marketing.



We’re looking for someone who understands good design, is creative, communicates well, and most importantly, is proactive.



You don’t necessarily need years of
 design experience. Experience with
 is a big plus, but if you’re a strong designer, the specifics of
 design can be learned.



What matters to us is that you can think for yourself, bring ideas, ask for feedback, and take initiative.





The Role



You’ll be the dedicated
 designer for one of our brands. Our other brand already has its own designer, so you’ll be able to really dive into this brand, understand its customers and visual identity, and become very familiar with what works for it.



You’ll work directly with our Head of Retention, who leads the
 strategy and direction, as well as the other designers on the team.



Your work goes further than simply receiving a finished wireframe and putting it together in Figma.



You’ll be involved in:



- Coming up with ideas and concepts for campaigns

- Designing campaigns and flows in Figma

- Writing and improving
 copy together with AI

- Building and setting up
s inside Klaviyo

- Finding the right imagery and content for your designs

- Thinking about layout, hierarchy, storytelling, and how to communicate an offer or message visually

- Bringing your own ideas to campaigns and discussions

- Asking for feedback and improving your work

- Participating in concepting, feedback, and strategy calls with the team



You’ll have freedom to be creative and bring your own input, while working within the strategy and direction set by the Head of Retention.



If you’re looking for a role where every concept, wireframe, asset, and piece of copy is completely prepared for you before you start designing, this probably isn’t the right fit.



We want a designer who enjoys being involved in the process.



What We’re Looking For



Must-have:



- Strong Figma skills

- A good understanding of design, including typography, hierarchy, spacing, composition, and layout

- Creativity and the ability to develop ideas visually

- Fluent spoken and written English

- Good communication skills

- Proactive attitude

- Attention to detail

- Comfortable asking questions and requesting feedback

- Able to work independently when needed

- Able to overlap with European / Amsterdam working hours (CET/CEST)



Big plus:



- Previous
 design experience

- Experience with Klaviyo

- Experience with Photoshop

- Experience with AI image generation

- Experience using AI for copywriting or creative workflows

- Experience with e-commerce or DTC brands

- Advanced Klaviyo knowledge such as dynamic blocks, personalization, or conditional content



Being Proactive Is Important



This is probably the most important part of the role besides being a good designer.



We don’t want someone who finishes an assigned task and then simply waits until another task appears.



If you have room in your schedule, look at what’s coming up. Ask what you can work on. Review previous designs. Bring an idea. Ask for feedback. Suggest something we could test or improve.



You don’t need to lead the strategy, but we do want you to contribute to it.



We want someone who becomes a genuine part of the team rather than someone we only communicate with when a design needs to be made.



About the Brand



You’ll be designing for our men’s belt brand.



We’ve recently expanded the brand with a completely new Outdoor collection, alongside our existing Classic collection. This gives us a lot of new products, photography, use cases, stories, and creative directions to work with.



We’re currently working on taking the overall
 design to the next level and making our campaigns more varied, visual, and interesting.



There’s plenty of room to experiment and bring new ideas into the brand.



How We Work



We use:



- Figma for design

- Klaviyo for
 marketing

- Slack for daily communication

- Notion for planning and workflows

- AI tools to help with copywriting, ideation, and creative work



You’ll have regular communication with the team and participate in feedback, concepting, and strategy calls.



Most communication happens around European / Amsterdam time (CET/CEST), so reasonable overlap with these hours is important.



We’ll initially start with a smaller number of hours per week depending on your availability and fit. There are plenty of hours available within the department for the right person, and we’re looking for someone we can work with long-term.



To Apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio –
 design examples are a big plus, but we’re also interested in other work that demonstrates that you’re a strong designer.

2. A short introduction – Tell us about your design experience, Figma experience, and any experience you have with
 marketing, Klaviyo, Photoshop, or AI tools.

3. (IMPORTANT) A short introduction video – Tell us a little about yourself, what you’ve worked on, and why you’re interested in the role.



We’re not looking for someone who checks every possible box.



We’re looking for a good designer who communicates well, is eager to learn, brings ideas, and takes initiative.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
TO APPLY PLEASE CLICK HERE: 



We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Accountant with robust US GAAP and controllership experience to anchor our accounting function during a pivotal period of growth and transformation.



Our current team handles day-to-day transactional processing and routine bookkeeping efficiently. However, as we advance through an active audit, a major software migration, and broader process improvement initiatives, we require a senior-level technical expert. Your primary focus will not be high-volume transactional work, but rather providing the deep accounting judgment, rigorous review capabilities, and control structures needed to ensure absolute technical accuracy and audit readiness.



You will partner directly with leadership to bridge the gap between day-to-day operations and high-level strategic financial oversight.



Key Responsibilities & Challenges to Solve:



*Technical GAAP & Specialized Accounting

- Fixed Assets & Capitalization: Oversee PPE accounting, refine and enforce capitalization policies, manage asset disposals, evaluate impairment considerations, and ensure the fixed asset register is flawlessly maintained.

- Technical GAAP Review: Act as the critical second line of defense. Review complex transactions, contract assessments, and financing arrangements, making definitive accounting treatment decisions before they become audit findings.



*Controllership, Month-End, & Oversight

- Month-End Close & Accruals: Partner with leadership to strengthen accrual methodologies, strictly enforce cut-off procedures, and significantly reduce the manual adjustments identified during close.

- Balance Sheet Reconciliations & Controls: Establish and enforce elevated reconciliation standards, design stronger review controls, and foster clear ownership across all key accounts.

- Audit Management & Documentation: Prepare detailed audit schedules, reports, and technical documentation for review by management and external auditors, ensuring full compliance with US GAAP standards.



*Process Improvement & System Transformation

- System Migration & Workflow Design: Active partner in our upcoming software migration. Document current processes, identify internal control gaps, redesign workflows, and ensure complex accounting requirements are accurately mapped into the new system.

- Fraud Prevention & Risk Mitigation: Continually assess financial risk, investigate discrepancies, and implement improvements to internal control systems to prevent errors and fraud.



Qualifications & Requirements:



- Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and required experience with QuickBooks Online. Experience with NetSuite is preferred, along with familiarity navigating complex accounting systems and software migrations

- Experience: Proven experience as a Senior Accountant, Financial Auditor, or Assistant Controller with deep, hands-on expertise in US GAAP and complex capitalization policies.

- Analytical Depth: Exceptional analytical skills with a proven ability to interpret complex financial data and apply high-level accounting judgment.

- Execution: Strong organizational skills with a meticulous attention to detail. Ability to work independently, manage shifting timelines, and thrive in a fully remote environment.

- Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of educating staff on policies and presenting clear findings to external auditors and leadership.

title: Industrial Piping Estimator - Takeoff from Isometric Drawings (QA)
description:
Purplefish is a well-funded tech startup based in New York City. We build software that does automated material and labor takeoff from piping isometric drawings for industrial contractors and pipe fabricators in the US. Our QA team already includes 2 amazing teammates in the Philippines who have been with us for over two years, and we're growing it.



REQUIRED: 

1) MUST have industrial piping estimation (quantity surveying and costing) experience including labor takeoff from piping ISOs.

2) Can work roughly 3-8pm EST, Mon-Thurs



THIS IS NOT A TRADITIONAL QUANTITY SURVEYING/ESTIMATION JOB. You'll use your estimation skills in a new way: checking the work of software instead of producing bids. It's a rare chance to sit at the intersection of tech and the trade you know. Your findings directly shape how the product improves every week, and you'll get deep exposure to how modern software is built while doing work only an experienced piping estimator can do.





WHAT YOU'LL DO

- QA our software's take-offs from piping ISOs for our customers: find mistakes, missed items, and wrong counts

- Do independent manual labor take-offs from isometric drawing packages so we can compare results and measure accuracy. This means genuinely interpreting the ISO drawings, not just counting symbols



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Industrial Piping Estimators

- Real experience doing material AND labor takeoffs from piping isometrics (industrial work: oil and gas, chemical, power, process plants). Quantity surveying (QS) or mechanical engineering backgrounds welcome

- You can read ISOs, spool drawings, and spec sheets confidently: fittings, valves, welds, bolt-ups, pipe schedules. 

- Detail-obsessed. You enjoy finding the error nobody else caught

- Strong written and spoken English. You'll be explaining errors to a US engineering team

-Part time and full time are both a possibility





OUR HIRING PROCESS

Shortlisted candidates will do a live takeoff assessment over video call, where you'll walk us through a take-off from a real ISO package and explain your reasoning as you go. This role requires genuine, demonstrated skill reading isometrics. Please only apply if you're confident doing this work live.



WHY JOIN

- Stable, long-term role with a funded company, not project work that dries up

- Work directly with the founders and engineering team

- Your expertise is the product's quality bar. This role has real influence



TO APPLY

Tell us briefly about your experience doing industrial piping estimation from ISOs, including weld counting. Also your preferred hours/time zone.

title: Virtual Assistant for Renovation Operations
description:
We’re looking for a sharp, proactive, and highly organised Renovation Operations Virtual Assistant to support the renovation lead of a fast-moving property investment and renovation business based in regional Australia.



Our renovation lead currently oversees more than 20 active renovation projects. His workday is fast-moving and often shaped by what is happening on-site, including trade availability, materials, property access, urgent repairs, payments, compliance requirements, and changing project priorities.



Your role will be to bring structure and follow-through to this workload. You will help turn calls, voice messages,
s, photos, videos, and brief instructions into clearly organised tasks—and then ensure those tasks continue moving until they are completed.



This is not a traditional inbox-and-calendar Executive Assistant role. It is a hands-on coordination and operations position for someone who can work quickly, use practical judgement, follow up confidently, and take ownership without needing constant supervision.



The position will begin part-time, with the potential to develop into a full-time role for the right person.



What you’ll be doing

- Managing renovation tasks, deadlines, notes, and follow-ups in ClickUp

- Turning
s, calls, voice messages, photos, and site updates into clear action items

- Monitoring projects and identifying urgent tasks, blockers, and missing information

- Preparing and updating scopes of work and trade job briefs

- Following up with trades, contractors, suppliers, and other parties

- Sourcing trades in regional Australian areas

- Maintaining contractor details, quotes, waivers, access information, and property records

- Assisting with preliminary costing, quantities, or estimating where appropriate

- Researching Australian rental, safety, and property-compliance requirements

- Preparing concise project updates covering progress, blockers, and next steps

- Creating practical checklists, templates, and SOPs

- Communicating delays early and providing clear completion estimates



Who we’re looking for

You may be a strong fit if you:

- Have experience in construction, renovation, property maintenance, project coordination, or operations support

- Work quickly without sacrificing accuracy

- Can organise incomplete or fast-moving information into clear next steps

- Take ownership and follow tasks through without repeated reminders

- Are confident following up with trades, contractors, and suppliers

- Can manage multiple projects and competing priorities

- Communicate clearly in written and spoken English

- Provide timely updates and raise blockers early

- Respond well to feedback and adapt quickly

- Are comfortable using ClickUp, Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and online document-management tools

- Can accurately track your working time

- Have reliable internet, a suitable workspace, and consistent availability



Highly regarded experience

Experience in any of the following would be an advantage:

- Residential construction or renovation

- Construction estimating or quantity surveying

- Architecture, interior design, or civil engineering

- Preparing scopes of work, job briefs, or cost estimates

- Reading property plans, inspection reports, and site documentation

- Sourcing and coordinating trades in Australia

- Australian building, rental, or property-compliance requirements



Relevant building, renovation, or estimating experience is preferred. We will also consider fast learners with strong initiative, practical judgement, and a genuine interest in renovation operations.



HOW TO APPLY

Please submit the following:

- A 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a strong fit for the role.

- Attach a copy of your most recent and updated CV.

- Share an example of a time you took ownership of a task or problem without being given detailed instructions.

- Confirm your current availability and preferred working hours in Melbourne time.



Applications without a Loom video and updated CV will not be considered. Please speak naturally in your video rather than reading from a prepared script.

title: Customer Service for Logistics
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and experienced Logistics Customer Service Specialist to join our team. This role is primarily responsible for managing the end-to-end order fulfillment process, coordinating with U.S.-based stakeholders, and ensuring seamless logistics operations. This position requires working on a fixed night shift schedule to align with U.S. business hours.



1. Responsibilities (Essential Duties)

- Order Management: Receive, review, and accurately enter customer orders into the system (WMS/ERP).

-Track & Trace: Proactively monitor shipments and provide real-time updates to clients regarding delivery status.

-Issue Resolution: Identify and resolve logistics disruptions (e.g., shipment delays, damages, or missing items) by coordinating with warehouses and carriers.

-Stakeholder Coordination: Act as a liaison between customers, warehouse operations, and transportation providers to ensure seamless fulfillment.

-Documentation: Prepare and manage essential logistics documents (Packing Lists, BOL, Invoices) and ensure all records are filed correctly.

-Reporting: Maintain and update daily/weekly shipping logs and provide performance data as requested.

-Compliance: Adhere to standard operating procedures (SOP) and logistics regulations.



2. Essential Skills & Qualifications (Updated)

-Experience: Must have over 3 years of experience in Logistics, Supply Chain, or Freight Forwarding. (Essential for understanding the end-to-end shipment lifecycle).

-Order Management: Proven track record of managing high-volume data entry with zero-error tolerance.

-Detail-Oriented: Exceptional accuracy in documentation (e.g., matching PO numbers, SKUs, and quantities).

-Problem-Solving: Ability to think critically and find alternative solutions during transportation disruptions or warehouse delays.

-Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills; must be comfortable communicating with B2B partners (Carriers, Warehouses, and Clients).

-Tech Savvy: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (e.g., Pivot Tables, V-LOOKUP) and experience with WMS, TMS, or ERP systems.

title: Sales & Estimating Coordinator – Landscaping | Aspire, GoHighLevel & AI
description:
Sales & Estimating Coordinator – Landscaping | Aspire, GoHighLevel & AI



IMPORTANT: LOOM VIDEO REQUIRED TO APPLY



Please do not apply until you have completed the Loom video instructions below.



We receive a high volume of applications and will only review candidates who submit the required Loom video with their application.



Your Loom video should be no longer than 5 minutes.



In your Loom video, please:



1. Introduce yourself and briefly explain your relevant work experience.

2. Tell us specifically about any experience you have with Aspire Landscape Software. If you have used Aspire, explain what you did inside the software.

3. Tell us about any experience you have with GoHighLevel and what you have built or managed within it.

4. Explain how you currently use AI tools such as ChatGPT to make your work faster or better.

5. Imagine a salesperson sends you customer meeting notes, a meeting transcript, voice recordings, photos, measurements, and project instructions. Explain how you would take that information and turn it into a polished customer proposal.

6. Please share your screen for at least a portion of the Loom and show us a software, workflow, system, or project you are comfortable using. Do not show confidential information belonging to a current or previous employer.

7. Tell us about any other skills you have that may be valuable to our company.



We are not looking for a professionally produced video. We want to see how you communicate, think, organize information, and use technology.



Please do not simply read an AI-generated script.



Applications without the required Loom link will not be considered.



IMPORTANT WORK SCHEDULE:



This position requires you to be available and working during our normal business hours of 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.



Please make sure you are comfortable consistently working these hours before applying.



ABOUT THE POSITION



Local Landscapers is a growing landscaping and outdoor construction company in Virginia, USA.



We are looking for a highly organized, technology-focused Sales & Estimating Coordinator to support our sales team.



This is not a traditional data-entry Virtual Assistant position.



Our salespeople spend their time meeting customers, visiting properties, understanding projects, taking measurements, developing solutions, selecting materials, and making the technical decisions required to build a project.



We need someone behind them who can take that information and quickly turn it into an organized, professional, customer-ready proposal.



The goal is simple:



Our salesperson provides the knowledge and technical decisions. You help build the finished product.



Over time, we want the right person to become an important part of our sales operation and help us process more opportunities without sacrificing speed, accuracy, or proposal quality.



WORK SCHEDULE



This is a full-time remote position.



You must be available and actively working from 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.



This schedule is important because you will work directly with our U.S.-based sales team throughout the day. Our salespeople will be completing appointments and sending information to you so proposals can begin being built as quickly as possible.



We are looking for someone who is comfortable working this schedule consistently and long term.



WHAT YOUR WORKFLOW MAY LOOK LIKE



A salesperson completes an appointment with a customer.



The meeting may be recorded and summarized using Otter.ai. The salesperson may also provide you with a Loom video, voice recording, photos, measurements, drawings, material selections, pricing information, and additional notes.



You will take that information and:



* Organize the customer's goals and project information

* Identify the individual services or line items being proposed

* Draft professional customer-facing scope descriptions

* Build and organize the proposal in Aspire

* Add appropriate photos, product information, drawings, and supporting materials

* Make sure the proposal clearly explains what is included and excluded

* Reference previous approved proposal templates and company standards

* Identify missing information instead of guessing

* Present the salesperson with a short, organized list of questions requiring their decision

* Prepare approximately 90% of the proposal for final salesperson review

* Make requested revisions quickly

* Help keep opportunities and follow-ups organized



Our goal is NOT for you to make technical landscaping or construction decisions that you are not qualified to make.



Our goal is for you to become extremely good at taking the salesperson's knowledge and turning it into a finished, polished sales package.



ASPIRE LANDSCAPE SOFTWARE



Experience with Aspire Landscape Software is STRONGLY PREFERRED.



If you have Aspire experience, we want to know specifically what you have done inside the platform, such as:



* Opportunities

* Estimating

* Proposals

* Catalog items

* Work tickets

* Customer information

* Scheduling/workflows

* Reporting

* Other Aspire functions



Aspire experience is a major advantage, but we will consider an exceptional candidate who demonstrates the ability to learn software quickly.



GOHIGHLEVEL



Experience with GoHighLevel is preferred.



As you grow into the position, you may also help us with:



* Sales pipelines

* Lead organization

* Automated
 and SMS follow-up

* Workflows and automations

* Tags and opportunity stages

* Unsold proposal follow-up

* Lead nurturing

* Old lead reactivation

* Marketing attribution

* Sales reporting

* CRM organization



You do not need to be an expert in every GoHighLevel feature on your first day.



AI IS PART OF THIS JOB



We actively use AI and want someone who is comfortable using it.



You should be able to use tools such as ChatGPT to help:



* Organize raw information

* Summarize meeting transcripts

* Draft proposal language

* Improve customer-facing writing

* Research products and materials

* Create repeatable templates

* Analyze information

* Improve workflows

* Work faster without sacrificing accuracy



We are not looking for someone who blindly copies and pastes AI-generated answers.



We want someone who knows how to give AI good information, review its output, catch mistakes, and turn it into useful finished work.



COMMUNICATION



This is a remote position, so strong asynchronous communication is extremely important.



Our company already uses Loom regularly.



You should be comfortable receiving instructions through:



* Loom videos

* Otter.ai transcripts and summaries

* Voice recordings

* Written notes

* Photos and videos

* Drawings

*
 and messaging



You should also be comfortable recording short Loom videos when showing us your work, asking a complicated question, or explaining an issue.



One of the most important skills for this position is knowing when you can figure something out yourself and when you need to ask the salesperson a question.



We do not want someone who guesses when important information is missing.



At the same time, we need someone who is resourceful and does not require constant supervision.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



You may be a great fit if you:



* Have excellent written and spoken English

* Are extremely comfortable working on a computer

* Work quickly and accurately

* Are highly organized

* Have excellent attention to detail

* Are comfortable learning new software

* Use AI regularly and intelligently

* Can take messy/raw information and organize it

* Can follow established systems and templates

* Can identify missing or conflicting information

* Are comfortable asking concise, specific questions

* Can work independently

* Enjoy building systems and improving processes

* Are interested in a long-term position where your responsibilities can grow

* Are able to consistently work 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday



Experience supporting a landscaping, construction, home-service, estimating, or sales organization is a major plus.



SOFTWARE & SKILLS WE VALUE



Experience with any of the following should be mentioned in your application:



* Aspire Landscape Software – strongly preferred

* GoHighLevel

* ChatGPT / AI tools

* Otter.ai

* Loom

* Google Workspace

* Google Sheets / Excel

* Canva

* CRM systems

* Estimating software

* Proposal-building software

* Construction or landscaping software



You do NOT need experience with every program listed above.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



A successful person in this role makes our salespeople more productive.



Instead of a salesperson spending significant time sitting at a computer building a proposal, we want them to be able to send you their information, move on to the next sales opportunity, and return later to a proposal that is approximately 90% complete.



A great handoff might look like:



"Proposal is ready for review. I need you to confirm these three technical questions. Everything else is complete."



We value:



Speed.

Accuracy.

Organization.

Initiative.

Excellent communication.

The ability to figure things out.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of our company.



This position may begin primarily focused on proposal and estimating support, but the right person could eventually take significant ownership of our sales operations, including Aspire, GoHighLevel, proposal systems, follow-up systems, reporting, AI workflows, and supporting additional salespeople as our company grows.



There is room for increased responsibility and compensation as you demonstrate your value and take ownership of more of the sales process.



PAID SKILLS TEST



Candidates who perform well during the initial application process may be invited to complete a PAID skills test.



The test will closely resemble the actual work you would perform in this position.



You may receive items such as:



* Customer meeting information

* Salesperson notes

* Photos

* Measurements

* Voice/video instructions

* Project information



You will then be asked to organize the information and build part of a customer proposal.



We encourage the use of AI during the test.



We are interested in seeing the quality, accuracy, organization, judgment, and speed of your finished work.



HOW TO APPLY



STEP 1 – REQUIRED:



Record your Loom video using the instructions at the very top of this job posting.



STEP 2:



Send us:



* Your Loom link

* Your resume/CV

* A brief written introduction

* Your experience with Aspire, if any

* Your experience with GoHighLevel, if any

* Your current availability

* Your desired weekly compensation

* Confirmation that you can consistently work 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday



Please put the words "SALES OPS" at the beginning of your written application.



This helps us confirm that you carefully read the entire posting.



Again:



APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A LOOM VIDEO WILL NOT BE REVIEWED.



We are looking for someone who wants to become excellent at this position, learn our company, and grow with us long term.

title: E-commerce Product Researcher (Winning Dropshipping Products)
description:
We run e-commerce stores and we are hiring a Product Researcher to find winning dropshipping products every day. You will find high-potential, visually appealing products that are proven to sell, and source a fast-shipping supplier for each one.



Daily target: 5 winning products, each with a sourced supplier. Quality is the priority. We are not looking for generic products. We want items that genuinely have the potential to sell. Any product niche is fine, as long as it fits the parameters.



What we are looking for in each product:



WOW FACTOR

Visually striking, giftable, impulse-buy items that look great in photos and video. Good categories: LED night lights and lamps, novelty games (mini golf, claw machine, foosball), aesthetic home décor (jellyfish lamps, planters, photo frames), and viral beauty or pet gadgets. Avoid generic everyday items and anything medical or health-related.

Price and margin. Selling price $29.99 to $99.99 (best $29.99 to $49.99), with a supplier cost low enough to keep at least a 3x markup (ideally 4 to 5x).



SHIPPING

Supplier from a fast lane: AliExpress Choice or US/local warehouse, CJdropshipping US warehouse, Amazon, or Walmart. Delivery within 10 days, ideally under 7.



PROVEN BUT FRESH

Real ad traction that is still scaling. Around 50 to 500 active ads. Skip anything with 1,000+ ads or that has been mainstream for years.



CREATIVE READY

At least 5 good photos or videos available.



TEST TASK (REQUIRED)



Send a minimum of 3 products that fit the criteria above. For each one, include: product name, competitor/store link,
 Ad Library link and number of active ads, their selling price, supplier link and platform, supplier unit cost, estimated shipping time, and your markup (selling price divided by cost).



Skills we prefer:

Dropshipping or e-commerce product research experience

Familiar with AliExpress, CJdropshipping, AutoDS, and
/TikTok ad research

Fast, reliable, communicates daily



How to apply: Reply with your product research experience and your completed test task (the 3 products with details above). Applications with a finished test task will be prioritized.

The ideal candidate is someone who can look at the numbers, understand what worked, and turn those insights into the next winning script.

title: Virtual Assistant & Shortform Video Editor (CapCut)
description:
I am a British-trained podiatrist based in Singapore. I run a clinic and I make video content about shoes and foot health for a large audience across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. I also work with footwear brands and I am building digital products.



I am looking for one organised, sharp assistant to take three things off my plate completely: my
 and calendar, the editing of my shortform videos, and my invoicing and admin.



This is a long term, full time role. I want someone who grows with the business, not someone passing through.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



1.
 MANAGEMENT

- Triage my inbox at the start and end of each day. Sort, file, and flag what needs me.

- Draft replies in my voice for routine
 using an approved reply library.

- Spot brand partnership enquiries and get them in front of me fast. These are the most valuable
s I receive.

- Never give health or footwear advice in a reply. Anything about pain or injury gets escalated to me. This is a hard rule.



2. CALENDAR MANAGEMENT

- Own my calendar end to end. Book, move, confirm and remind.

- Protect my clinic days. Thursday and Friday stay clear of business meetings, always.

- Schedule across time zones with the UK, US and Australia, and confirm the time zone in writing every time.

- Send me a two week look ahead every Friday with any clashes flagged.



3. SHORTFORM VIDEO EDITING

This is a real editing job, not just captioning. Here is exactly how it works.

- I write a script and film to it. I hand you the script, the raw footage, and a folder of b-roll clips. The b-roll placements are already marked in the script, so you are not guessing.

- The raw footage has mistakes in it. Stumbles, restarts, two or three takes of the same line.

- You build the video in CapCut. Pick the strongest take of each line, cut the stumbles and dead air, get the pacing tight, and drop the b-roll in where I marked it.

- You caption it accurately. Shoe brand names and anatomy terms spelled correctly, every time.

- You export for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and
, then schedule and file it.

- You draft the first pass of the written caption and hashtags for me to approve.

- Volume is 3 finished videos per week. Shortform only. I do not need you cutting my long YouTube videos.



4. INVOICING AND ADMIN

- Pull invoices and receipts out of my inbox, name them properly, and upload them to our accounting portal.

- Keep the expense and invoice trackers current, and clear the backlog I have let build up.

- Raise my brand partnership invoices when a collaboration is delivered, then chase them politely until they are paid.

- Handle routine supplier
: shipping, sizes, addresses, sample tracking.

- Send me one short weekly summary so I never have to go looking for any of it.





WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



- Excellent written English. You will be writing as my business, so this is not negotiable.

- You can genuinely edit in CapCut, not just add captions. You can take messy raw footage and make it tight, and you can show me work you cut yourself.

- A feel for pacing. You know when a video is dragging and you fix it without being asked.

- A power user of Gmail and Google Calendar, including time zones, labels and filters.

- Real attention to detail. A typo in a caption goes out to a lot of people.

- Comfortable with spreadsheets and admin detail. You notice when a number does not add up.

- You can work out what matters first without being told every time.

- Reliable. You communicate early and you own your mistakes.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience supporting a creator, a clinic or a personal brand.

- Familiarity with health, fitness or footwear content.

- Canva, scheduling tools, ManyChat or CRM experience.

- Any experience with bookkeeping or invoicing platforms.





THE DETAILS



- Full time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

- You need at least 6 hours of daily overlap with Singapore time, which is the same clock as Manila. Roughly 9am to 6pm.

- You need your own computer that can run CapCut on 1080p and 4K footage, and a stable internet connection of at least 25 Mbps with a backup option.

- Pay starts at $750 USD per month. It rises to $900 from month 4 if you hit the targets we agree at your 90 day review, and $1,050 from month 13 once you own the role fully. Plus 13th month pay.

- I would rather pay well for the right person long term than cheaply for the wrong one.

- This role grows as the business grows. There is scope to take on more content and product work over time.





HOW TO APPLY



Please include all of the following in your application.



1. Start your application with the words FEET FIRST. If those words are not there, I will not read it. This is my first check that you follow instructions carefully.



2. Links to two shortform videos you edited yourself from raw footage. Tell me exactly what you did on each one. If you only added the captions and someone else cut it, say so. Honesty here matters more to me than the portfolio.



3. A short note, no more than 200 words, telling me which part of this role you are strongest at and which part you would need to learn.



4. Answer this in writing: you open my inbox on a Monday morning and there are 40 unread
s. What do you look for first, and why?



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to do a short paid test task before any offer is made. 



Thank you for reading this far.



Paul

title: Publishing & Book Marketing Manager — Long-Term Fiction Series
description:
I'm looking for someone experienced with indie publishing and book marketing who can take over as much of that side of my business as possible so I can concentrate on writing.



The Perfection Cycle is a planned 10-book speculative-fiction series published under the pen name K.C. Finehope. Books 1–3 are completely finished and ready to publish, and Book 4 is well underway.



Book 1 is already set up on StoryOrigin with current review copies. The author website and MailerLite account are also set up, and I've previously published through Amazon KDP.



I don't need someone to teach me how to self-publish. I could learn the marketing side myself, but I don't want to spend my time doing that when I could be writing the next book. I'm looking for someone who already understands this business and can eventually run most of the publishing and marketing operation with minimal direction from me.



What I need



The immediate priority is getting Book 1 moving: StoryOrigin promotions, ARC/reviewer recruitment and follow-up, newsletter swaps, mailing-list growth, promotional opportunities, social media, and preparation for the KDP launch.



Books 2 and 3 are already finished, so this will quickly become series marketing rather than a one-book project.



Depending on your experience, I'd eventually like you to handle as much as possible of the following:



StoryOrigin and BookFunnel

ARC/review-team recruitment and management

MailerLite and
 marketing

Newsletter swaps and group promotions

KDP management

Metadata, categories and keywords

Launch and release strategy

Kindle Unlimited strategy

Pricing and promotions

Series read-through

Social media management and audience growth

Amazon Ads and Meta Ads

Promotional opportunities and outreach

Tracking results and adjusting the strategy based on what is actually working



You don't need to be an expert in every item on that list. I'd rather have someone be honest about what they know well and where they might eventually recommend bringing in outside expertise.



What matters most is that you understand indie publishing and book marketing, can work independently, and are comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting for me to provide a task list every day.



Why I want to move quickly



The series deals heavily with AI, synthetic companions, human/AI integration, labor displacement, relationships, and the social consequences of technological change.



Some things I originally wrote as speculative fiction are already beginning to happen in the real world. Reality is starting to catch up with the books, and I don't want them sitting on my hard drive while that happens.



That's one reason I already have three books finished before launching the series properly, and why I'm looking for someone who can start moving the marketing side forward while I continue writing.



Long-term opportunity



This isn't a one-book gig.



There are ten books planned, and I'm looking for someone who could potentially stay with the series for years. This will remain a part-time position, with the workload naturally increasing around launches and decreasing between releases.



Ideally, I want to reach the point where you run this side of the business and I write the books.



The posted hourly range is intentionally broad. For the right person, I'm open to discussing a compensation structure that includes meaningful long-term upside in addition to hourly pay. I'm interested in finding someone who wants to help build the series over time and benefit from its success, not simply complete a short-term assignment.



When you apply



Please tell me:



How much of the publishing and marketing operation described above you would be comfortable handling yourself.

With Books 1–3 ready and StoryOrigin already set up, what would you focus on first?

What experience you've had working with indie fiction authors, book launches, or ongoing author marketing.



You don't need to claim you can do everything. I'm much more interested in finding someone experienced, capable, reliable, and interested in building something long term than someone who checks every box.

title: AI Video Creator / Motion Designer (Contract or Part-Time)
