This is the tone, pacing, and visual standard we are targeting. Your work does not need to match a $500K production budget, but it needs to match the FEEL. Here is what makes this commercial work — and what we need you to replicate:



TONE



Authoritative but not aggressive. Confident, measured, quiet power.

Feels like a prestige drama, not a sales pitch.

The narrator (Schreiber) speaks TO the viewer as an equal — not down to them, not hyping them up. Straightforward. Intelligent. Calm.

No hype. No "act now." No countdown timers. No stock-photo energy.



VISUAL STYLE



Cinematic color grading: desaturated, cool tones, deep contrast.

Clean, modern typography — data and numbers appear on screen as the narrator references them. Sans-serif. White or gold on dark.

Real-world footage intercut with data visualizations and motion graphics.

Slow, deliberate camera movement. No fast cuts. Each shot breathes.

Dynamic visuals proving scale — numbers animate in, graphics build.

Dark backgrounds dominate. Light is used intentionally, not flooded.



PACING



Measured. Every sentence gets space. No rush.

Music is low, cinematic, ambient — supports the voice, never competes.

Roughly 1 key visual per sentence. Not cluttered.

The viewer should feel like they are watching something important.

SOUND



Deep, resonant voiceover — professional narrator with gravitas.

Minimal sound design. No whooshes, no stingers, no comedic beats.

Subtle ambient score. Cinematic. Think Hans Zimmer at 10% volume.



WHAT YOU WILL PRODUCE

3-minute educational videos (we provide the scripts). Initial batch of 22 videos across 5 modules, plus 4 marketing/ad videos.



Topics include:



The Rockefeller Method (what it is, how it works)

Velocity Banking (debt elimination strategy)

Capital Deployment (real estate, oil & gas)

Tax Strategy (cost segregation, bonus depreciation)

Case Studies (military officer, pilot, engineer, veteran)

Marketing ads (The Problem, The System, The Execution, The Offer)

For each video, you will receive:



Full script with dialogue and scene descriptions

Visual direction notes (shot types, graphics, animations)

Brand guidelines (colors, fonts, logo placement)

You will deliver:



Finished 3-minute video (1920x1080 or 4K, .mp4)

Vertical cut for social (9:16, 60-second highlight)

Thumbnail image (1280x720)



REQUIRED SKILLS

MUST HAVE: 

[ ] Proficiency with AI video generation tools (Runway, Pika, Kling, Sora, HailuoAI, or similar). You should be producing with these daily. 

[ ] Strong motion graphics ability (After Effects, or AI equivalent). Animated typography, data visualizations, flow diagrams. 

[ ] Understanding of cinematic color grading and composition. 

[ ] Ability to source or generate high-quality voiceover (ElevenLabs, professional VO talent, or your own studio-quality voice). 

[ ] Clean, modern design sensibility. If your portfolio has neon gradients, particle effects, or "techy" overlays, this is not the right fit.



NICE TO HAVE:

[ ] Experience with financial services, real estate, or insurance content. 

[ ] Familiarity with the Infinite Banking Concept or wealth strategy space.

[ ] Ability to produce cinematic b-roll using AI (cityscapes, office environments, family scenes, military settings). 

[ ] Music licensing or production (or access to Artlist, Epidemic Sound).



DO NOT APPLY IF:



Your work looks like a TikTok edit or a "motivational" Instagram reel.

You rely on stock footage montages with no original motion design.

You cannot match the desaturated, high-contrast, dark visual palette shown in the reference video.

You think "corporate video" means bright blue backgrounds with icons flying around. That is the opposite of what we want.



PORTFOLIO LINK

Show us 3–5 pieces that demonstrate the cinematic, authoritative tone described above. If nothing in your current portfolio matches, produce a 30-second sample using one of our scripts (provided on request).



TOOLS LIST 

Tell us exactly which AI tools you use for generation, editing, motion graphics, voiceover, and music. We want to know your actual workflow, not a list of tools you have heard of.



TURNAROUND ESTIMATE

 How many days per finished 3-minute video? Be realistic. We value quality over speed, but we need a sustainable cadence.



RATE 

Per-video rate for the deliverables described above (landscape video, vertical cut, thumbnail). If you prefer hourly, state that.



ONE SENTENCE

Watch the Comcast reference video and tell us in one sentence what makes it work. This tells us whether you see what we see.



TIMELINE & VOLUME

Phase 1: 4 marketing videos (highest priority — paid ads) 

Phase 2: Module 1 (5 videos) — Rockefeller Method foundations 

Phase 3: Modules 2–5 (17 videos) — ongoing, 2–3 per week



Total: 26 videos over approximately 10–12 weeks. Ongoing work available as we expand the curriculum and ad campaigns.



ABOUT THE ROLE

This is not a one-off gig. We are building a media engine. The right person becomes our go-to video creator across all four entities (Velocity Capital, Anza Ventures, Anza Realtor, Anza Construction). Consistent work, clear creative direction, and scripts provided for every piece.



We are looking for someone who takes pride in craft. Someone who watches the Comcast spot and thinks: 

"I can do that — and I can do it faster with AI."

title: Creator Partnerships Manager (Part-Time)
description:
Creator Partnerships Manager (Part-Time, Remote)



Type: Part-time, 20 hours per week (4 hours/day, Monday to Friday) Salary: $450 – $600 USD/month, depending on experience.





ABOUT US

We are a European e-commerce brand selling personalised jewelry. Small team, direct communication, everything in English.



We run a creator program where content creators receive free product, make short-form video, and earn commission on the sales their content generates. It works. It just needs someone who runs it properly, every day.





THE ROLE

You own our creator program end to end.



Managing the creator pipeline. Every creator moves through a number of stages before their first video goes live. You keep track of exactly where each one is, follow up on a fixed rhythm, and chase our suppliers when a sample is delayed. You tell the creator what's happening before they have to ask.



Finding new creators. You get a fixed number of invitations to send every working day, and you use all of them. Not on the biggest accounts, on the right ones: clean natural-light filming, strong close-up work, an audience that actually engages.



Reviewing video. This is where the job gets interesting. Every video is checked against our written standard before it goes live. Clear yes or no, and when it's a no you tell the creator exactly what to change. The founder reviews alongside you for the first two weeks so you learn what we look for. After that it's yours.



Seasonal campaigns. Christmas, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day. You set these up in advance and brief our best creators, so the content exists before the season starts instead of during it.





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We can teach you our product. We can teach you our platform. We cannot teach you attention to detail.



The person we want notices that the hook lands at four seconds instead of two. That the product goes out of focus in the third shot. That a creator's last three posts got half the engagement of the ones before. That the tracker says "shipped" but the tracking number never moved.



Most people watch a video and say "nice, good lighting". We are looking for the person who says "no, and here is exactly why, and here is what to change".



That is the whole job. Everything else is process.





REQUIRED

- 2+ years managing creators, influencers or affiliate partners for a brand or agency

- Excellent written English. You write to creators in the US and Europe every day and it has to sound human

- A genuine eye for video. You can watch ten seconds and name what works and what doesn't

- Self-managing. You track things without being asked and follow up without being reminded

- Comfortable in Google Sheets



A plus:

- Experience with a creator platform such as Trybe, Aspire, GRIN or similar

- E-commerce or Shopify background

- Jewelry, fashion or beauty



Not needed:

- You do not edit video yourself





WHO THIS SUITS

Nobody will hand you a daily task list. You get clear targets and freedom in how you hit them.



Creators are busy and get approached by a lot of brands. If following up with someone for the third time makes you uncomfortable, this will frustrate you. If you enjoy turning a quiet list into an active one, you will like it here.





HOW TO APPLY

We get a lot of applications and most of them are clearly written by AI. We can tell, and it never works in your favour. We would rather read three honest sentences from you than three polished paragraphs from a chatbot.



So skip the cover letter. Just tell us two things, in your own words:



One brand where you managed creators. How many, over what period, and what you did about the ones who went quiet. Numbers help.



Why you think you are the right person for this one. Not why you want a job. Why this one.



Write it like you would explain it to someone over coffee. That is all we need to start a conversation.

title: Graphic designer for Meta
description:
# E-commerce Graphic Designer — Meta Ads | Long-Term Role



**Salary: $6–$8/hour to start + opportunity to grow**

**Hours: 20–40 hours/week**

**Location: Remote — Philippines**

**Position: Long-term**



LumeWorks is a fast-growing Dutch e-commerce brand focused on projectors and home entertainment.



We're growing quickly, and we're looking for a talented Graphic Designer who wants to grow with us.



This is NOT a one-time freelance project.



We're looking for someone who can become a real part of our team for the long term.



If you're looking for stable, ongoing work where you can develop your skills, take on more responsibility and increase your compensation as you grow with the company, keep reading.



## Your main responsibility



Your #1 focus will be creating scroll-stopping static ads for Meta 
 & Instagram).



We don't just want beautiful designs.



We want designs that sell.



You'll turn creative concepts, references and marketing angles into ads that make people stop scrolling, understand the message and take action.



You'll also create:



* Static Meta ads

* Creative variations for A/B testing

* Social media content

* Website banners

* Product graphics

* Promotional campaigns

* Landing page visuals

* Other marketing assets



You'll work directly with our team and receive briefs, references, brand assets and feedback.



## We're NOT looking for someone who...



Simply opens Canva, picks a template and changes the text.



We're looking for someone who understands:



* Visual hierarchy

* Typography

* Composition

* Product presentation

* Direct-response advertising

* E-commerce

* Why some ads stop the scroll and others don't



Photoshop and/or Figma experience is strongly preferred.



Experience creating ads for DTC or e-commerce brands is a big advantage.



## What we expect from you



We move fast.



That means you need to be:



* Reliable

* Creative

* Fast

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable with feedback

* Able to meet deadlines

* Able to communicate clearly in English

* Flexible when priorities change

* Available during weekends when needed



We don't expect you to work 7 days a week.



But e-commerce doesn't always run Monday to Friday. Occasionally, an important campaign, promotion or creative needs to be finished during the weekend.



We need someone who can be flexible when that happens.



## Why LumeWorks?



We're not building a team of random freelancers.



We want people who grow with us.



LumeWorks is growing quickly, and we want your role to grow with the company.



If you're great at what you do, there will be opportunities for:



* More responsibility

* More hours

* Higher compensation

* Performance bonuses

* Working on bigger campaigns

* Becoming a key member of our creative team



Your work won't disappear into a folder.



You'll see your designs launched in real advertising campaigns and learn which creatives actually generate sales.



That means you'll become a better performance designer, not just a better graphic designer.



And when you help us grow, we want you to benefit from that growth too.



## Compensation



**Starting rate: $6–$8 USD/hour depending on experience and portfolio.**



We're happy to increase compensation for people who consistently deliver great work and become more valuable to the company.



We're looking for a long-term relationship, so we'd rather reward great people and keep them with us than constantly hire new freelancers.



## How to apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your portfolio

3. Your 5 best e-commerce / Meta ad designs

4. Which programs you use

5. Your experience with e-commerce brands

6. Your expected hourly rate

7. How many hours per week you're available

8. Your normal working hours in Philippine Time

9. Your availability during weekends



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word "CINEMA".



If your application doesn't start with CINEMA, we won't review it.



This is simply to make sure you've actually read the full job post.



### One final question:



What do you think makes a static
/Instagram ad convert?



There is no perfect answer.



We simply want to understand how you think.



If you're talented, ambitious, reliable and looking for a company where you can stay and grow for the long term, we'd love to hear from you.

We're excited to see what you can create.

title: 3D STL Mesh Repair & 3D Printing Assistant
description:
I need someone experienced with 3D printing files to help prepare STL/3MF/OBJ models for printing.



The first job is straightforward: I have existing 3D models that need to be resized, repaired, oriented correctly, and exported as clean printable files without damaging the geometry.



You should know how to:



• Resize STL/OBJ/3MF meshes to exact dimensions

• Repair broken/non-manifold meshes

• Reduce extremely large mesh/file sizes without destroying important detail

• Check wall thickness

• Make models watertight/manifold

• Fix models that are not sitting correctly on the build plate

• Separate or combine mesh parts when necessary

• Correct orientation for 3D printing

• Prepare models for FDM and resin printing

• Export clean STL and 3MF files

• Preserve as much original detail as possible



Software experience with Blender, Meshmixer, Fusion 360, Rhino, Netfabb, PrusaSlicer, Bambu Studio, Lychee, Chitubox or similar tools is useful.



I use both FDM and resin 3D printers, so understanding actual printability is important. I do NOT only need someone who knows how to visually resize an object. You need to understand meshes and how changing a model affects the finished print.



For the first paid test, I will provide one problem 3D file and the dimensions I need.



You will return:



1. Original-quality repaired model

2. Resized printable STL

3. 3MF version when appropriate

4. Recommended print orientation

5. Short explanation of any problems you found in the original mesh



If the first project goes well, there will be ongoing work involving fashion accessories, jewelry, combs, wearable products, prototypes, product development and preparation of models for manufacturing.



When applying, please send:



• Examples of STL/mesh repair work

• Software you use

• Your experience preparing models for 3D printing

• Whether you understand both resin and FDM printing

• Your price for repairing/resizing one test file



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words “MESH READY” so I know you read the entire job description.
